Superseded by https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62382, which uses the current `rfc-hint` branch. This draft is closed.

---

## Purpose

This is our **draft reference implementation of [RFC #57103: Programmable KV Cache](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/57103)**, shared for design discussion and implementation review. It does not close the RFC or claim complete acceptance.

Agentic sessions span multiple inference requests, tool pauses, and branches. The RFC lets an application express lifecycle and cache intent through the existing `KvHintsEnvelope`, while the engine resolves targets, approves resources, executes operations, and reports actual completion.

### How this implementation maps to the RFC

- **Common control and logical state:** request-attached hints and independent Python/HTTP control share the envelope, dispatcher, and engine approval path. Hash/session/continuation/range selectors resolve logical content separately from physical residency. Results are correlated by message/action IDs, with bounded replay, queries, ACK, cancellation, and engine epochs. Existing backend-owned KVCR payloads retain opaque forwarding.
- **Execution through existing cache infrastructure:** `SET_PRIORITY`, `COPY_TO`, and `MOVE_TO` use `KVCacheManager`/`BlockPool` and CPU/Mooncake Store adapters. GPU-source operations run at successful request completion before references are released; accepted transfers can outlive the request. COPY publishes reusable GPU content only after all participating ranks finish. MOVE stores first and reclaims eligible source copies afterward. Shared loads share reservations and transfer holds; a resume can wait for an existing load.
- **Optional policies and rollout integration:** retention, tool-wait movement, and quota/prefix-reuse scheduling consume engine observations and submit proposals through the same approval boundary. Explicit commands keep their meaning. Startup configuration controls policy registration. The benchmark harness connects real verl `ToolAgentLoop` calls, tools, token logprobs, response masks, and rewards; weight-update checks exercise draining, invalidation, and cache namespace isolation.

Implementation contracts: [native primitives and lifecycle](https://github.com/zhhangBian/vllm-note/blob/rfc-57103-reference/vllm/v1/kv_hints/README.md). Reproduction: [benchmark commands](https://github.com/zhhangBian/vllm-note/blob/rfc-57103-reference/benchmarks/programmable_kv_cache/README.md).

### Current conclusions

Recorded local experiments use Qwen3.8-27B BF16, two A100 80GB GPUs, TP=2, concurrency 16, and 32 rollouts from 8 GSM8K questions. Each fixed-work replay has 113 model calls and 8,121 output tokens. The principal comparisons use three runs per configuration and report median throughput relative to native APC at the **same GPU KV budget**; movement additionally uses a host Store.

| GPU KV per GPU          | Configuration                 | Native / reference elapsed | Throughput change |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------- | -------------------------: | ----------------: |
| 2 GiB, constrained      | Quota/prefix-reuse scheduling |          449.06 / 219.63 s |           +104.5% |
| 2 GiB, constrained      | Retention + movement + quota  |          449.06 / 247.60 s |            +81.4% |
| 8 GiB, working set fits | Retention + movement + quota  |            54.09 / 56.13 s |             -3.6% |

These measurements support executable lifecycle/resource contracts and a scheduling benefit under constrained KV capacity. They do **not** establish an additional benefit from movement/composition over quota alone, or a general serving speedup. The 2 GiB setting is an artificial pressure diagnostic. When the working set fits, both arms have zero preemptions and equal cache hits; control overhead produces a regression.

Separate live tool runs took 452.37 / 288.73 / 214.34 s for native/full-policy/quota, each scoring 32/32 rewards. These are single runs with different generated trajectories and only 8 independent questions. Fixed replay reruns model generation but does not rerun tools or evaluate rewards.

The [experiment report](https://github.com/zhhangBian/vllm-note/blob/rfc-57103-reference/docs/programmable-kvc/rollout-report-2026-10-12.md) records variability, tail-latency regressions, missing Store objects, methodology, and unfinished acceptance. Raw traces/logs remain local and are not included in this PR.

### Related work and remaining scope

Duplicate checks covered #57103's discussion, open PRs referencing it, and KV-hint/programmable-cache searches. [#58198](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/58198) supplies a minimal request-free CPU-to-GPU primitive; [#59714](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/59714) and [#38514](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/38514) cover retention priority. This reference has a broader purpose: a runnable control/lifecycle/resource/execution path plus policy and rollout experiments. Its overlapping primitive, dispatcher, and priority code needs consolidation with those contributions before upstream merge. The experimental COPY/MOVE schema follows the direction discussed in #59708 and remains open to revision.

This draft preserves development baseline `30f5c01d4ebb5c493ed86195db24d0ec5b3ce3d7` and currently has conflicts with upstream `main`. Rebase and validation against current `main` remain open. Other gaps include the full prediction/fairness/outage/restart matrix, a fresh final 128-question evaluation, other models/layouts, Dynamo/llm-d integration, and full RL trainer/optimizer performance. CPU control requires one block per chunk; native Mooncake movement requires PCP=DCP=1. Cold-tier retention/deletion and mixed native/backend envelopes are unsupported.

@@ -0,0 +1,232 @@
+# Programmable KV Cache 测试命令
+
+- [分支实现与验证结果](../../docs/programmable-kvc/testing.md)
+- [已执行实验报告](../../docs/programmable-kvc/rollout-report-2026-10-12.md)
+- [当前与历史证据索引](../../openspec/changes/programmable-kv-cache/validation.md)
+- [原语与生命周期契约](../../vllm/v1/kv_hints/README.md)
+
+以下命令从仓库根目录执行，Python 使用 `.venv/bin/python`。
+本地只使用 GPU 0、3；性能、模型正确性和其他回归安排在独立窗口。
+模型/数据路径可替换为对应本地副本。
+`results/` 保存本地实验输出，已加入 `.gitignore`，原始轨迹、日志和采样文件不随代码提交。
+复现命令中的 `--trace` 指向本地已有轨迹；新环境需用下面的在线采集命令生成轨迹，并替换该路径。
+
+## 在线 rollout 与重复性能对照
+
+`verl_rollout.py` 使用真实 verl ToolAgentLoop、题目查询与算术工具，保存 token 对数概率、响应掩码、奖励分数和控制结果。
+需要可导入的 verl 仓库及其 Agent Loop 依赖；本轮使用的提交为 `fbb4b3a8bf636f290c9c59fc346f756849e9c241`。
+
+实验设置与计时说明见[实验报告](../../docs/programmable-kvc/rollout-report-2026-10-12.md)。
+
+对已配置的服务采集在线轨迹：
+
+```bash
+PYTHONPATH=../verl \
+  CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,3 \
+  OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 \
+  .venv/bin/python -m benchmarks.programmable_kv_cache.verl_rollout \
+  --base-url http://127.0.0.1:18083 \
+  --model /home/youwei/bzh/model/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B \
+  --dataset /home/youwei/bzh/dataset/openai/gsm8k \
+  --mode native \
+  --prompts 8 \
+  --samples 4 \
+  --families 8 \
+  --fewshot 48 \
+  --concurrency 16 \
+  --max-tokens 256 \
+  --temperature 0.6 \
+  --seed 0 \
+  --output /tmp/kv-live-trace.json.gz
+```
+
+`run_rollout_matrix.py` 创建并清理本次测试的服务、Mooncake Store 和 GPU 采样进程；所需端口被占用时拒绝启动。
+它排除启动与显式预热时间，检查缓存重置成功，并记录配置、命令、源码摘要和逐轮数据。
+以下只复现已经记录的 8 GiB 容量充足点，不定义正常部署预算：
+
+```bash
+.venv/bin/python -m benchmarks.programmable_kv_cache.run_rollout_matrix \
+  --model /home/youwei/bzh/model/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B \
+  --dataset /home/youwei/bzh/dataset/openai/gsm8k \
+  --trace benchmarks/programmable_kv_cache/results/rollout-2026-10-11/optimized-native-live.json.gz \
+  --gpus 0,3 \
+  --cache-gib 8 \
+  --concurrency 16 \
+  --arms native,policy \
+  --repeats 3 \
+  --output-dir /tmp/kv-fit-reproduce
+```
+
+| 参数/模式 | 用途 |
+| --- | --- |
+| `native` / `noop` | 原生 APC；或启用控制器和连接器，但不发送 hint |
+| `priority` / `movement` / `composed` | 应用端显式保留、搬运、二者组合 |
+| `policy` | 信号驱动的本地策略与调度 |
+| `--policy-components quota` | 在 `policy` 配置中仅启用配额调度 |
+| `--cache-gib 2` | 历史人工配额压力诊断；不要当作正常资源主基线 |
+| `--live-after-replay` | 缓存重置后按 trace 的原在线配置运行真实工具循环，结果单列 |
+| `--trace` | 固定原输入、输出长度和暂停，重新生成；不执行工具或报告回放奖励分数 |
+| `--tool-delay` / `--replay-pause-floor` | 明确标记的人为工具等待；不能代替真实服务延迟 |
+| `--oracle` / `--prediction-seconds` | 回放预测诊断；检查实际信号及派生 COPY 覆盖 |
+| `--enforce-eager` / `--disable-custom-all-reduce` | 显式诊断选项；不与默认编译/图执行的速度混算 |
+
+矩阵当前 `--concurrency` 同时设置客户端并发与服务 `max_num_seqs`。
+扩大工作负载前，应分别设置客户端与服务并发，并按实际部署确定各对照配置共同使用的 KV 预算。
+
+## 功能测试的服务配置
+
+文本/Qwen TP=2 功能服务示例，固定 4 GiB KV/卡用于正确性检查：
+
+```bash
+CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,3 \
+  OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 \
+  VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn \
+  .venv/bin/python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
+  --model /home/youwei/bzh/model/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B \
+  --served-model-name qwen-validation \
+  --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
+  --max-model-len 4096 \
+  --max-num-seqs 8 \
+  --max-num-batched-tokens 2048 \
+  --kv-cache-memory-bytes 4294967296 \
+  --mamba-cache-mode align \
+  --dtype bfloat16 \
+  --enable-prefix-caching \
+  --enable-prompt-tokens-details \
+  --enforce-eager \
+  --disable-custom-all-reduce \
+  --kv-control-config '{"engine_id":"kv-validation"}' \
+  --host 127.0.0.1 \
+  --port 18083
+```
+
+Mooncake 数据面另启动隔离 Store：
+
+```bash
+.venv/bin/mooncake_master \
+  --rpc_address=127.0.0.1 \
+  --rpc_port=19151 \
+  --metrics_host=127.0.0.1 \
+  --metrics_port=19153 \
+  --enable_metric_reporting=false
+```
+
+将客户端配置保存为 `/tmp/programmable-kv-mooncake-config.json`：
+
+```json
+{
+  "metadata_server": "P2PHANDSHAKE",
+  "master_server_address": "127.0.0.1:19151",
+  "protocol": "tcp",
+  "device_name": "",
+  "global_segment_size": "8GB",
+  "local_buffer_size": "256MB"
+}
+```
+
+启动功能服务时设置 `MOONCAKE_CONFIG_PATH` 为该文件，并增加：
+
+```bash
+--kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"MooncakeStoreConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_connector_extra_config":{"enable_lookup":false,"enable_save":false,"save_decode_cache":false}}'
+```
+
+关闭普通请求的缓存查找与写入，使显式 COPY/MOVE 的效果可单独测量。
+CPU 功能检查则使用以下连接器，无需 Mooncake Store：
+
+```bash
+--kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"OffloadingConnector","kv_role":"kv_both","kv_connector_extra_config":{"cpu_bytes_to_use":8589934592,"blocks_per_chunk":1}}'
+```
+
+原生 Mooncake 路径要求目标与完整的主缓存项及各缓存组边界对齐，预填充和解码的上下文并行度均为 1（PCP=DCP=1）。
+通用 CPU 路径要求每个传输单元（chunk）包含一个缓存块，暂不支持 CPU Share。
+其他布局应通过 `capabilities` 查询实际支持范围。
+
+## 功能测试驱动
+
+请求完成时 MOVE、下次入口 COPY：
+
+```bash
+CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,3 \
+  .venv/bin/python -m benchmarks.programmable_kv_cache.primitive_control \
+  --base-url http://127.0.0.1:18083 \
+  --engine-id kv-validation \
+  --dataset /home/youwei/bzh/dataset/openai/gsm8k \
+  --output /tmp/kv-attached.json
+```
+
+独立控制、真实复用与可选质量检查：
+
+```bash
+CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,3 \
+  .venv/bin/python -m benchmarks.programmable_kv_cache.http_control \
+  --base-url http://127.0.0.1:18083 \
+  --dataset /home/youwei/bzh/dataset/openai/gsm8k \
+  --primitive-actions \
+  --validate-movement mooncake \
+  --validate-request-associations \
+  --output /tmp/kv-independent.json
+```
+
+使用 CPU 服务时将 `--validate-movement` 的值改成 `cpu`；该驱动在推理时禁用自动 CPU 加载。
+加 `--evaluation-samples 128` 做质量门槛，加 `--destination-url` 验证兼容目的引擎的实际命中。
+两个服务须采用相同模型、布局、Store 与并行设置，各有独立引擎 ID；同用 GPU 0/3 时两者均可采用 `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.45`，目的端口用 18084。
+
+| 入口 | 参数和前置条件 |
+| --- | --- |
+| `lifecycle.py` | `--base-url --trace --output`；原生控制与 Mooncake，检查共享分支、TTL、取消和恢复竞争 |
+| `weight_update.py` | `--base-url --model --trace --output`；同机 GPU、对应模型检查点、IPC 权重传输后端和 Store |
+| `evaluate.py` | `--model --dataset --output`，可加 `--enable-kv-control`；重算/APC 质量基线 |
+| `control_overhead.py` | `--output`；测量 CPU 元数据操作，不代表推理服务或 RL 吞吐 |
+| `run_recovery.py` | 自建服务/Store，`--model --dataset --trace --output-dir`，可加 `--evaluation-samples 128`；新组合测试驱动尚未执行 |
+
+IPC 权重检查要求服务额外启用 `--weight-transfer-config '{"backend":"ipc"}'`，设置 `VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE=1` 与既有同机 IPC 序列化配置 `VLLM_ALLOW_INSECURE_SERIALIZATION=1`，服务保持绑定本地地址。
+脚本修改真实 GPU 参数并回滚，未执行优化器更新。
+其他示例不需要这些权重更新设置。
+
+策略在启动时通过 `--kv-control-config` 配置，空 `policies` 使信号不产生策略动作。
+`primitive_control.py --policy` 的专用服务可用：
+
+```json
+{
+  "engine_id": "kv-policy",
+  "policies": [
+    {
+      "name": "retention",
+      "implementation": "retention"
+    },
+    {
+      "name": "movement",
+      "implementation": "tool_wait",
+      "options": {
+        "tier": "mooncake"
+      }
+    }
+  ]
+}
+```
+
+对该服务使用 `--engine-id kv-policy --policy`。
+`http_control.py` 的协议检查使用无策略或不消费工具信号的配置。
+`signal` 完成表示策略处理了信号；派生 COPY 等操作必须分别查询，完成后才表示缓存准备就绪。
+收集同一消息中的全部动作及派生操作结果后再 ACK。
+`residency` 返回查询时的 GPU 状态快照，历史 COPY 成功不保证之后持续驻留。
+`client.py` 与 `rollout.py` 共享提示消息和结果协议。

+测试范围与执行证据见[分支汇报](../../docs/programmable-kvc/testing.md)，分阶段回归结果见[实验报告](../../docs/programmable-kvc/rollout-report-2026-10-12.md)。

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Small control helpers shared by the real-server examples."""
+
+import time
+from typing import Any
+
+ACTIVE = {"received", "queued", "accepted", "running"}
+
+
+def envelope(message_id: str, kind: str, payload: dict[str, Any], version: str = "1.0"):
+    return {
+        "protocol_version": "0.1",
+        "message_id": message_id,
+        "actions": [
+            {
+                "action_id": "action",
+                "action_type": kind,
+                "action_version": version,
+                "payload": payload,
+            }
+        ],
+    }
+
+
+def wait_operation(
+    call, message_id: str, action_id: str = "action", *, timeout: float = 120
+):
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
+    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+        result = call("operation", {"message_id": message_id, "action_id": action_id})
+        if result["message_id"] != message_id or result["action_id"] != action_id:
+            raise AssertionError("Control result lost caller correlation")
+        if result["status"] not in ACTIVE:
+            return result
+        time.sleep(0.02)
+    raise TimeoutError(f"KV operation {message_id}/{action_id} did not finish")

+"""Measure CPU result polling and cached policy guidance; no GPU serving work."""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import statistics
+import time
+from functools import partial
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config.kv_control import KVControlConfig, KVPolicyConfig
+from vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_manager import KVCacheManager
+from vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_utils import BlockHash, make_block_hash_with_group_id
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import (
+    FullAttentionSpec,
+    KVCacheConfig,
+    KVCacheGroupSpec,
+)
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.control import ControlContext, OperationRegistry, OperationStatus
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.controller import NativeKVController
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.policy_runtime import KVPolicyRuntime
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.protocol import KvHintAction, KvHintsEnvelope
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.retention import RetentionDeclarations
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.state import SessionPrefixIndex
+
+
+def measure(function, iterations, repeats):
+    samples = []
+    for _ in range(repeats):
+        start = time.perf_counter_ns()
+        for _ in range(iterations):
+            function()
+        samples.append((time.perf_counter_ns() - start) / iterations / 1000)
+    return {"median_us": statistics.median(samples), "samples_us": samples}
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--repeats", type=int, default=5)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.repeats < 1:
+        parser.error("--repeats must be positive")
+    report = {
+        "scope": "cpu_only_no_requests",
+        "repeats": args.repeats,
+        "measurements": {},
+    }
+    results = report["measurements"]
+    context = ControlContext("engine", "epoch", "native")
+    for records in (64, 4096):
+        registry = OperationRegistry("engine", engine_epoch="epoch", clock=lambda: 0.0)
+        for i in range(records):
+            result = registry.submit(
+                KvHintsEnvelope(
+                    "0.1",
+                    str(i),
+                    [
+                        KvHintAction("a", "signal", "1", {}),
+                    ],
+                ),
+                context,
+            ).results[0]
+            registry.update(result, OperationStatus.COMPLETED)
+        results[f"poll_{records}_results"] = measure(
+            partial(registry.get, "0", "a"),
+            3000,
+            args.repeats,
+        )
+    index = SessionPrefixIndex("namespace", "epoch")
+    controller = NativeKVController(registry, index, RetentionDeclarations(index))
+    settings = KVControlConfig(
+        policies=[KVPolicyConfig(name="quota", implementation="quota")]
+    )
+    for blocks in (10000, 100000):
+        spec = FullAttentionSpec(
+            block_size=16, num_kv_heads=1, head_size=16, dtype=torch.float16
+        )
+        manager = KVCacheManager(
+            KVCacheConfig(blocks, [], [KVCacheGroupSpec(["layer"], spec)]),
+            max_model_len=128,
+            scheduler_block_size=16,
+            hash_block_size=16,
+        )
+        runtime = KVPolicyRuntime(
+            settings,
+            controller,
+            manager,
+            lambda: (),
+            clock=lambda: 0.0,
+            wall_clock=lambda: 0.0,
+        )
+        runtime.observe_requests()
+        results[f"cached_guidance_{blocks}_blocks"] = measure(
+            runtime.observe_requests, 100, args.repeats
+        )
+        results[f"fresh_observation_{blocks}_blocks"] = measure(
+            runtime.observation, 100, args.repeats
+        )
+        pool = manager.block_pool
+        allocated = pool.get_new_blocks(blocks - 1)
+        for block in allocated:
+            key = make_block_hash_with_group_id(
+                BlockHash(block.block_id.to_bytes(8, "big")), 0
+            )
+            pool.cache_transferred_block(block, key, 16)
+        pool.free_blocks(allocated)
+        results[f"populated_observation_{blocks}_blocks"] = measure(
+            runtime.observation, 100, args.repeats
+        )
+    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
+    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+
+import argparse
+import json
+import random
+import time
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import pyarrow.parquet as pq
+import regex as re
+
+from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams

+
+def answer_number(text: str) -> str | None:
+    values = re.findall(r"-?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?", text.split("####")[-1])
+    if not values:
+        return None
+    try:
+        return str(Decimal(values[-1].replace(",", "")).normalize())
+    except InvalidOperation:
+        return None
+
+
+def validate_control(llm: LLM) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    capabilities = llm.get_kv_control_capabilities()
+    assert len(capabilities) == 1
+    caps = capabilities[0]
+    invocation = {key: caps[key] for key in ("engine_id", "engine_epoch", "namespace")}
+
+    def submit(name, action_type, payload):
+        return llm.kv_control(
+            "submit",
+            invocation,
+            {
+                "protocol_version": "0.1",
+                "message_id": name,
+                "actions": [
+                    {
+                        "action_id": "action",
+                        "action_type": action_type,
+                        "action_version": "1",
+                        "payload": payload,
+                    }
+                ],
+            },
+        )
+
+    associated = submit(
+        "associate",
+        "associate",
+        {
+            "session_id": "evaluation",
+            "continuation_id": "main",
+            "expected_revision": 0,
+            "target": {"kind": "hashes", "namespace": caps["namespace"], "blocks": []},
+        },
+    )
+    assert associated["results"][0]["status"] == "completed"
+    payload = {
+        "target": {
+            "kind": "session",
+            "session_id": "evaluation",
+            "continuation_id": "main",
+        },
+        "owner_id": "evaluation",
+        "declaration_id": "retain",
+        "priority": 50,
+        "ttl_seconds": 300,
+        "scope": "follow_growth",
+    }
+    retained = submit("retain", "retain", payload)
+    assert retained["results"][0]["status"] == "completed"
+    assert submit("retain", "retain", payload)["replayed"]
+    queried = llm.kv_control(
+        "operation", invocation, {"message_id": "retain", "action_id": "action"}
+    )
+    assert queried == retained["results"][0]
+    events = llm.kv_control("events", invocation, {"stream": "operation"})
+    assert events[-1] == queried
+    try:
+        llm.kv_control("associations", {**invocation, "engine_epoch": "stale"}, {})
+    except ControlError as error:
+        assert error.code == "stale_epoch"
+    else:
+        raise AssertionError("Stale epoch was accepted")
+    signal = submit(
+        "signal", "signal", {"target": payload["target"], "signal": "tool_wait"}
+    )
+    assert signal["results"][0]["status"] == "unconsumed"
+    revision = llm.kv_control("associations", invocation, {})["revision"]
+    finished = submit(
+        "finish",
+        "finish_task",
+        {"session_id": "evaluation", "expected_revision": revision},
+    )
+    assert finished["results"][0]["status"] == "completed"
+    assert llm.kv_control("associations", invocation, {})["items"] == []
+    return {
+        "capabilities": caps,
+        "request_free_lifecycle": "passed",
+        "cache_transfer_tested": False,
+    }
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--model", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--dataset",
+        type=Path,
+        required=True,
+        help="Downloaded GSM8K repository containing main/*.parquet",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--num-samples", type=int, default=128)
+    parser.add_argument("--num-fewshot", type=int, default=8)
+    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument("--tensor-parallel-size", type=int, default=2)
+    parser.add_argument("--max-model-len", type=int, default=4096)

+    parser.add_argument("--kv-cache-memory-bytes", type=int, default=4 << 30)
+    parser.add_argument("--min-accuracy", type=float, default=0.8)
+    parser.add_argument("--max-accuracy-drop", type=float, default=0.01)
+    parser.add_argument("--enable-kv-control", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    train = pq.read_table(
+        args.dataset / "main/train-00000-of-00001.parquet"
+    ).to_pylist()
+    test = pq.read_table(args.dataset / "main/test-00000-of-00001.parquet").to_pylist()
+    if not 0 < args.num_samples <= len(test) or not 0 <= args.num_fewshot <= len(train):
+        parser.error("Invalid sample or few-shot count")
+    indices = random.Random(args.seed).sample(range(len(test)), args.num_samples)
+    examples = train[: args.num_fewshot]
+    llm_args = {
+        "model": args.model,
+        "tensor_parallel_size": args.tensor_parallel_size,
+        "max_model_len": args.max_model_len,
+        "max_num_seqs": 8,
+        "max_num_batched_tokens": 2048,
+        "kv_cache_memory_bytes": args.kv_cache_memory_bytes,
+        "enable_prefix_caching": True,
+        "mamba_cache_mode": "align",
+        "enforce_eager": True,
+        "disable_custom_all_reduce": True,
+        "dtype": "bfloat16",
+    }
+    if args.enable_kv_control:
+        llm_args["kv_control_config"] = {"engine_id": "evaluation"}
+    llm = LLM(**llm_args)
+    report: dict[str, Any] = {
+        "configuration": llm_args,
+        "seed": args.seed,
+        "num_fewshot": args.num_fewshot,
+        "prompt_format": "gsm8k_completion_cot",
+        "sampling": {"temperature": 0, "max_tokens": args.max_tokens},
+        "thresholds": {
+            "min_accuracy": args.min_accuracy,
+            "max_accuracy_drop": args.max_accuracy_drop,
+            "max_truncated_fraction": 0.01,
+        },
+        "indices": indices,
+        "runs": {},
+    }
+    try:
+        if args.enable_kv_control:
+            report["control"] = validate_control(llm)
+        report["cache_groups"] = llm.llm_engine.engine_core.call_utility(
+            "get_kv_cache_group_metadata"
+        )
+        tokenizer = llm.get_tokenizer()
+        shared = "".join(
+            f"Question: {example['question']}\nAnswer: {example['answer']}\n\n"
+            for example in examples
+        )
+        shared_tokens = len(tokenizer.encode(shared, add_special_tokens=False))
+        assert shared_tokens >= max(g["block_size"] for g in report["cache_groups"]), (
+            "Few-shot prefix is too short to exercise this model's reusable boundaries"
+        )
+        prompts = [
+            {
+                "prompt_token_ids": tokenizer.encode(
+                    shared + f"Question: {test[i]['question']}\nAnswer:",
+                    add_special_tokens=False,
+                )
+            }
+            for i in indices
+        ]
+        assert (
+            max(len(p["prompt_token_ids"]) for p in prompts) + args.max_tokens
+            <= args.max_model_len
+        )
+        llm.generate(
+            prompts[:1], SamplingParams(temperature=0, max_tokens=8), use_tqdm=False
+        )
+        for mode, skip in (("recompute", True), ("prefix_cache", False)):
+            assert llm.reset_prefix_cache()
+            started = time.perf_counter()
+            outputs = llm.generate(
+                prompts,
+                SamplingParams(
+                    temperature=0,
+                    max_tokens=args.max_tokens,
+                    stop=["Question:", "Assistant:", "<|separator|>"],
+                    skip_reading_prefix_cache=skip,
+                ),
+                use_tqdm=False,
+            )
+            elapsed = time.perf_counter() - started
+            rows = []
+            for index, output in zip(indices, outputs, strict=True):
+                assert output.prompt_token_ids is not None
+                completion = output.outputs[0]
+                predicted = answer_number(completion.text)
+                expected = answer_number(test[index]["answer"])
+                rows.append(
+                    {
+                        "index": index,
+                        "expected": expected,
+                        "predicted": predicted,
+                        "correct": expected is not None and predicted == expected,
+                        "text": completion.text,
+                        "token_ids": list(completion.token_ids),
+                        "finish_reason": completion.finish_reason,
+                        "prompt_tokens": len(output.prompt_token_ids),
+                        "cached_tokens": output.num_cached_tokens,
+                    }
+                )
+            accuracy = sum(row["correct"] for row in rows) / len(rows)
+            report["runs"][mode] = {
+                "seconds": elapsed,
+                "accuracy": accuracy,
+                "length_limited": sum(row["finish_reason"] == "length" for row in rows),
+                "rows": rows,
+            }
+            args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
+            print(
+                json.dumps(
+                    {
+                        "mode": mode,
+                        "samples": len(rows),
+                        "accuracy": accuracy,
+                        "length_limited": report["runs"][mode]["length_limited"],
+                        "cached_tokens": sum(row["cached_tokens"] or 0 for row in rows),
+                    }
+                ),
+                flush=True,
+            )
+        baseline, cached = report["runs"]["recompute"], report["runs"]["prefix_cache"]
+        report["answer_mismatches"] = sum(
+            a["predicted"] != b["predicted"]
+            for a, b in zip(baseline["rows"], cached["rows"], strict=True)
+        )
+        report["token_mismatches"] = sum(
+            a["token_ids"] != b["token_ids"]
+            for a, b in zip(baseline["rows"], cached["rows"], strict=True)

+        args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")

+        assert cached["length_limited"] <= 0.01 * args.num_samples
+        assert min(baseline["accuracy"], cached["accuracy"]) >= args.min_accuracy
+        assert baseline["accuracy"] - cached["accuracy"] <= args.max_accuracy_drop
+    finally:
+        llm.llm_engine.engine_core.shutdown()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Validate HTTP control against a real server and observable GPU cache reuse."""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import math
+import random
+import time
+import uuid
+from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+import pyarrow.parquet as pq
+import requests
+
+from vllm import SamplingParams
+from vllm.utils.hashing import get_hash_fn_by_name
+from vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_utils import (
+    get_none_hash_seed,
+    get_request_block_hasher,
+    init_none_hash,
+)
+from vllm.v1.request import Request
+
+if __package__:
+    from .client import ACTIVE, wait_operation
+    from .client import envelope as make_envelope
+    from .evaluate import answer_number
+else:
+    from client import ACTIVE, wait_operation
+    from client import envelope as make_envelope
+    from evaluate import answer_number
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--base-url", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--dataset", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--validate-request-associations", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--validate-movement", choices=("cpu", "mooncake"))
+    parser.add_argument("--evaluation-samples", type=int, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument("--destination-url")
+    parser.add_argument("--primitive-actions", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.evaluation_samples and not args.validate_movement:
+        parser.error("Movement evaluation requires --validate-movement")
+    if args.destination_url and args.validate_movement != "mooncake":
+        parser.error("Cross-engine preparation requires Mooncake movement")
+    session = requests.Session()
+    run_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
+    report: dict[str, Any] = {"base_url": args.base_url, "actions": {}, "inference": []}
+
+    def post(path, body, *, base_url=None):
+        response = session.post(
+            (base_url or args.base_url) + path, json=body, timeout=180
+        )
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        return response.json()
+
+    caps = session.get(args.base_url + "/v1/kv/capabilities", timeout=30).json()[
+        "engines"
+    ]
+    assert len(caps) == 1
+    caps = caps[0]
+    report["capabilities"] = caps
+    invocation = {key: caps[key] for key in ("engine_id", "engine_epoch", "namespace")}
+
+    priority_targets = {}
+    report["action_profile"] = "rfc59708" if args.primitive_actions else "legacy"
+
+    def envelope(name, kind, payload, version="1"):
+        if args.primitive_actions and version == "1":
+            if kind == "retain":
+                key = payload["owner_id"], payload["declaration_id"]
+                priority_targets[key] = payload["target"]
+                kind, version, payload = (
+                    "vllm.set_priority",
+                    "1.0",
+                    {
+                        "target": payload["target"],
+                        "location": "local_g1",
+                        "claim_id": "/".join(key),
+                        "revision": 1,
+                        "value": payload["priority"],
+                        "ttl_seconds": payload["ttl_seconds"],
+                    },
+                )
+            elif kind == "release":
+                key = payload["owner_id"], payload["declaration_id"]
+                kind, version, payload = (
+                    "vllm.set_priority",
+                    "1.0",
+                    {
+                        "target": priority_targets[key],
+                        "location": "local_g1",
+                        "claim_id": "/".join(key),
+                        "revision": 2,
+                        "value": None,
+                    },
+                )
+            elif kind in ("demote", "prefetch", "share"):
+                primitive = "vllm.move_to" if kind == "demote" else "vllm.copy_to"
+                source = payload["source"] if kind == "prefetch" else "gpu"
+                destination = (
+                    "gpu"
+                    if kind == "prefetch"
+                    else payload.get("destination", "mooncake")
+                )
+                kind, version, payload = (
+                    primitive,
+                    "1.0",
+                    {
+                        "target": payload["target"],
+                        "src": {"tier": source},
+                        "dst": {"tier": destination},
+                    },
+                )
+        return make_envelope(run_id + "-" + name, kind, payload, version)
+
+    def control(method, payload):
+        return post(
+            "/v1/kv/control",
+            {"method": method, "invocation": invocation, "payload": payload},
+        )
+
+    def submit(name, kind, payload, version="1", *, call=control):
+        result = call("submit", envelope(name, kind, payload, version))
+        report["actions"][name] = result
+        queried = operation(name, call=call)
+        initial = result["results"][0]
+        assert queried["operation_id"] == initial["operation_id"]
+        assert queried["sequence"] >= initial["sequence"]
+        if initial["status"] not in ACTIVE:
+            assert queried == initial
+        return result
+
+    def operation(name, *, call=control):
+        return call(
+            "operation", {"message_id": run_id + "-" + name, "action_id": "action"}
+        )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""R1 MOVE at completion, R2 COPY at admission, using real Mooncake and inference."""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import math
+import uuid
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pyarrow.parquet as pq
+import requests
+
+if __package__:
+    from .client import envelope, wait_operation
+else:
+    from client import envelope, wait_operation
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--base-url", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--engine-id", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--dataset", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, type=Path)
+    parser.add_argument("--tier", choices=("mooncake", "cpu"), default="mooncake")
+    parser.add_argument("--policy", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    session = requests.Session()
+    base = args.base_url.rstrip("/")
+    run = uuid.uuid4().hex
+    report = {"profile": "request_attached_primitives", "actions": {}, "inference": []}
+
+    def get(path):
+        response = session.get(base + path, timeout=30)
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        return response.json()
+
+    def post(path, payload):
+        response = session.post(base + path, json=payload, timeout=180)
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        return response.json()
+
+    engines = [
+        e
+        for e in get("/v1/kv/capabilities")["engines"]
+        if e["engine_id"] == args.engine_id
+    ]
+    assert len(engines) == 1, engines
+    caps = engines[0]
+    report["capabilities"] = caps
+    invocation = {k: caps[k] for k in ("engine_id", "engine_epoch", "namespace")}
+
+    def control(method, payload):
+        return post(
+            "/v1/kv/control",
+            {"method": method, "invocation": invocation, "payload": payload},
+        )
+
+    def wait(name):
+        result = wait_operation(control, run + "-" + name)
+        report["actions"][name] = result
+        return result
+
+    model = get("/v1/models")["data"][0]["id"]
+    train = pq.read_table(
+        args.dataset / "main/train-00000-of-00001.parquet"
+    ).to_pylist()
+    text = "".join(
+        f"Question: {x['question']}\nAnswer: {x['answer']}\n\n" for x in train[:8]
+    )
+    text += "Question: What is 1 + 1?\nAnswer:"
+    tokens = post("/tokenize", {"model": model, "prompt": text})["tokens"]
+    boundary = math.lcm(
+        *(
+            g["block_size"]
+            for g in caps["cache_profile"]["groups"]
+            if g["prefix_cacheable"]
+        )
+    )
+    end = len(tokens) // boundary * boundary
+    assert end > 0
+    selector = {"kind": "request", "request_id": "$request", "end_token": end}
+
+    def infer(hints=None):
+        body = {
+            "model": model,
+            "prompt": tokens,
+            "temperature": 0,
+            "max_tokens": 16,
+            "return_token_ids": True,
+            "cache_salt": run,
+        }
+        if hints is not None:
+            body["kv_hints"] = hints
+        if args.tier == "cpu":
+            body["kv_transfer_params"] = {"max_load_tokens": 0}
+        response = post("/v1/completions", body)
+        report["inference"].append(response)
+        return response
+
+    report["passed"] = False
+    try:
+        first = infer(
+            envelope(
+                run + "-move",
+                "vllm.move_to",
+                {
+                    "target": selector,
+                    "src": {"tier": "gpu"},
+                    "dst": {"tier": args.tier},
+                },
+            )
+        )
+        moved = wait("move")
+        assert moved["status"] == "completed", moved
+        assert moved["target_outcomes"] and all(
+            "cold_copy_stored" in o["completed_steps"]
+            and "gpu_copies_reclaimed" in o["completed_steps"]
+            for o in moved["target_outcomes"]
+        ), moved
+        resumed = infer(
+            envelope(
+                run + "-copy",
+                "vllm.copy_to",
+                {
+                    "target": selector,
+                    "src": {"tier": args.tier},
+                    "dst": {"tier": "gpu"},
+                },
+            )
+        )
+        copied = wait("copy")
+        assert copied["status"] == "completed" and copied["target_outcomes"], copied
+        assert all(
+            o["transfer_id"] is not None
+            and "gpu_content_registered" in o["completed_steps"]
+            for o in copied["target_outcomes"]
+        ), copied
+        assert first["choices"][0]["token_ids"] == resumed["choices"][0]["token_ids"]
+        assert first["usage"]["prompt_tokens_details"]["cached_tokens"] == 0
+        assert resumed["usage"]["prompt_tokens_details"]["cached_tokens"] >= end
+        if args.policy:
+            target = {
+                "kind": "hashes",
+                "namespace": caps["namespace"],
+                "blocks": [
+                    {
+                        k: outcome[k]
+                        for k in ("block_hash", "group_id", "start_token", "end_token")
+                    }
+                    for outcome in copied["target_outcomes"]
+                ],
+            }
+            for name, signal in (
+                ("policy-move", "tool_wait"),
+                ("policy-copy", "resume"),
+            ):
+                receipt = control(
+                    "submit",
+                    envelope(
+                        run + "-" + name,
+                        "signal",
+                        {"target": target, "signal": signal},
+                        "1",
+                    ),
+                )
+                parent = receipt["results"][0]
+                assert (
+                    parent["status"] == "completed" and parent["derived_operations"]
+                ), parent
+                children = [
+                    wait_operation(control, child["message_id"], child["action_id"])
+                    for child in parent["derived_operations"]
+                ]
+                assert all(child["status"] == "completed" for child in children), (
+                    children
+                )
+                report["actions"][name] = {"parent": parent, "children": children}
+            again = infer()
+            assert again["usage"]["prompt_tokens_details"]["cached_tokens"] >= end
+            assert again["choices"][0]["token_ids"] == first["choices"][0]["token_ids"]
+        report["passed"] = True
+    except Exception as error:
+        report["error"] = str(error)
+        raise
+    finally:
+        args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        args.output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
+        session.close()
+    print(
+        json.dumps(
+            {
+                "passed": True,
+                "cached_tokens": resumed["usage"]["prompt_tokens_details"][
+                    "cached_tokens"
+                ],
+            }
+        )
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""Real HTTP generation and bounded application control for rollout workloads."""
+
+import asyncio
+import hashlib
+import json
+import math
+import time
+import uuid
+from contextlib import suppress
+from typing import Any
+
+import httpx
+
+from benchmarks.programmable_kv_cache.client import ACTIVE, envelope
+
+
+class RolloutClient:
+    def __init__(self, base_url: str, mode: str, *, seed: int = 0):
+        self.http = httpx.AsyncClient(
+            base_url=base_url, timeout=600, limits=httpx.Limits(max_connections=256)
+        )
+        self.mode = mode
+        self.seed = seed
+        self.run_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
+        self.rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+        self.controls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+        self.turns: dict[str, int] = {}
+        self.targets: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+        self.background: dict[str, asyncio.Task] = {}
+        self.resume_events: dict[str, asyncio.Event] = {}
+        self.pending_moves: dict[str, str] = {}
+        self.invocation: dict[str, str] = {}
+        self.boundary = 1
+
+    async def initialize(self) -> None:
+        response = await self.http.get("/v1/models")
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        self.model = response.json()["data"][0]["id"]
+        response = await self.http.get("/v1/kv/capabilities")
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        engines = response.json()["engines"]
+        if len(engines) > 1:
+            raise ValueError("Use an HTTP endpoint pinned to one explicit engine")
+        self.capabilities = engines[0] if engines else None
+        if self.capabilities is not None:
+            self.invocation = {
+                key: self.capabilities[key]
+                for key in ("engine_id", "engine_epoch", "namespace")
+            }
+            self.boundary = math.lcm(
+                *(
+                    group["block_size"]
+                    for group in self.capabilities["cache_profile"]["groups"]
+                    if group["prefix_cacheable"]
+                )
+            )
+        elif self.mode not in ("native", "noop"):
+            raise ValueError("The selected arm requires programmable KV control")
+
+    async def call(self, method: str, payload: dict) -> Any:
+        response = await self.http.post(
+            "/v1/kv/control",
+            json={
+                "method": method,
+                "invocation": self.invocation,
+                "payload": payload,
+            },
+        )
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        return response.json()
+
+    async def wait(
+        self,
+        message_id: str,
+        action_id: str = "action",
+        *,
+        timeout: float = 30,
+        acknowledge: bool = True,
+    ) -> dict:
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout
+        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+            result = await self.call(
+                "operation",
+                {
+                    "message_id": message_id,
+                    "action_id": action_id,
+                },
+            )
+            if result["status"] not in ACTIVE:
+                children = [
+                    await self.wait(
+                        child["message_id"], child["action_id"], acknowledge=False
+                    )
+                    for child in result.get("derived_operations", [])
+                ]
+                result["children"] = children
+                self.controls.append(result)
+                messages = {child["message_id"] for child in children}
+                if acknowledge:
+                    messages.add(message_id)
+                for message in messages:
+                    try:
+                        await self.call("acknowledge", {"message_id": message})
+                    except httpx.HTTPStatusError as error:
+                        if error.response.json().get("error", {}).get("code") != "busy":
+                            raise
+                return result
+            await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
+        raise TimeoutError(f"Control operation timed out: {message_id}")
+
+    async def action(
+        self,
+        kind: str,
+        payload: dict,
+        *,
+        version="1.0",
+        attempts: int = 2,
+        submitted: asyncio.Event | None = None,
+    ) -> dict:
+        for attempt in range(attempts):
+            message = f"{self.run_id}-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
+            receipt = None
+            started = time.perf_counter()
+            try:
+                receipt = await self.call(
+                    "submit", envelope(message, kind, payload, version)
+                )
+                if submitted is not None:
+                    submitted.set()
+                result = await self.wait(message)
+            except (httpx.HTTPError, TimeoutError) as error:
+                self.controls.append(
+                    {"status": "client_error", "error": str(error), "action_type": kind}
+                )
+                if receipt is not None:
+                    for parent in receipt["results"]:
+                        for ref in [parent, *parent.get("derived_operations", [])]:
+                            with suppress(httpx.HTTPError):
+                                cancelled = await self.call(
+                                    "cancel",
+                                    {
+                                        key: ref[key]
+                                        for key in (
+                                            "message_id",
+                                            "action_id",
+                                            "operation_id",
+                                        )
+                                    },
+                                )
+                                self.controls.append(cancelled)
+                if attempt + 1 == attempts:
+                    return {"status": "failed", "reason": str(error)}
+            else:
+                result["driver_seconds"] = time.perf_counter() - started
+                if kind == "signal":
+                    result["driver_signal"] = payload["signal"]
+                    result["driver_resume_after_seconds"] = payload.get(
+                        "resume_after_seconds"
+                    )
+                if result["status"] != "deferred" or attempt + 1 == attempts:
+                    return result
+            finally:
+                if submitted is not None:
+                    submitted.set()
+            await asyncio.sleep(0.02 * (2**attempt))
+        raise AssertionError("Unreachable")
+
+    async def generate(
+        self,
+        request_id: str,
+        prompt_ids: list[int],
+        sampling_params: dict,
+        *,
+        fixed_tokens: int | None = None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> dict:
+        started = time.perf_counter()
+        turn = self.turns.get(request_id, 0)
+        self.turns[request_id] = turn + 1
+        pending = self.background.pop(request_id, None)
+        if pending is not None:
+            self.resume_events.pop(request_id).set()
+            await pending
+        continuation = f"turn-{turn}"
+        session = f"{self.run_id}-{request_id}"
+        body: dict[str, Any] = {
+            "model": self.model,
+            "prompt": prompt_ids,
+            "temperature": sampling_params.get("temperature", 0),
+            "top_p": sampling_params.get("top_p", 1),
+            "max_tokens": fixed_tokens or sampling_params.get("max_tokens", 256),
+            "seed": self.seed
+            + turn
+            + int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(request_id.encode()).digest()[:4], "big")
+            % 1000000,
+            "stream": True,
+            "stream_options": {"include_usage": True},
+            "return_token_ids": True,
+            "logprobs": 0,
+            "cache_salt": self.run_id,
+            "session_id": session,
+        }
+        for key in ("stop", "stop_token_ids", "repetition_penalty"):
+            if key in sampling_params:
+                body[key] = sampling_params[key]
+        if fixed_tokens is not None:
+            body["ignore_eos"] = True
+            body.pop("stop", None)
+            body.pop("stop_token_ids", None)
+        association = None
+        if self.mode not in ("native", "noop"):
+            end = len(prompt_ids) // self.boundary * self.boundary
+            if end:
+                association = f"{session}-{continuation}"
+                body["kv_hints"] = envelope(
+                    association,
+                    "associate",
+                    {
+                        "session_id": session,
+                        "continuation_id": continuation,
+                        "expected_revision": 0,
+                        "observe_growth": True,
+                        "task_parent_id": kwargs.get("task_parent_id"),
+                        "parent_prefix": kwargs.get("parent_prefix"),
+                        "target": {
+                            "kind": "request",
+                            "request_id": "$request",
+                            "end_token": end,
+                        },
+                    },
+                    "1",
+                )
+                self.targets[request_id] = {
+                    "kind": "session",
+                    "session_id": session,
+                    "continuation_id": continuation,
+                }
+                if self.mode in ("movement", "composed"):
+                    body["kv_hints"]["actions"].append(
+                        {
+                            "action_id": "move",
+                            "action_type": "vllm.move_to",
+                            "action_version": "1.0",
+                            "payload": {
+                                "target": {
+                                    "kind": "request",
+                                    "request_id": "$request",
+                                    "end_token": end,
+                                },
+                                "src": {"tier": "gpu"},
+                                "dst": {"tier": "mooncake"},
+                            },
+                        }
+                    )
+                    self.pending_moves[request_id] = association
+        sent = time.perf_counter()
+        first_token = None
+        ids, logprobs = [], []
+        text = ""
+        usage = {}
+        finish = None
+        async with self.http.stream("POST", "/v1/completions", json=body) as response:
+            if response.is_error:
+                await response.aread()
+                response.raise_for_status()
+            async for line in response.aiter_lines():
+                if not line.startswith("data: ") or line == "data: [DONE]":
+                    continue
+                item = json.loads(line[6:])
+                if "error" in item:
+                    raise RuntimeError(item["error"])
+                if item.get("usage"):
+                    usage = item["usage"]
+                for choice in item.get("choices", []):
+                    tokens = choice.get("token_ids") or []
+                    if tokens and first_token is None:
+                        first_token = time.perf_counter()
+                    ids.extend(tokens)
+                    text += choice.get("text", "")
+                    logprobs.extend(
+                        (choice.get("logprobs") or {}).get("token_logprobs", [])
+                    )
+                    finish = choice.get("finish_reason") or finish
+        finished = time.perf_counter()
+        if not ids:
+            raise RuntimeError("Generation returned no token IDs")
+        row = {
+            "request_id": request_id,
+            "turn": turn,
+            "prompt_ids": prompt_ids,
+            "token_ids": ids,
+            "log_probs": logprobs,
+            "text": text,
+            "started": started,
+            "finished": finished,
+            "seconds": finished - started,
+            "prepare_wait_seconds": sent - started,
+            "ttft": (first_token or finished) - started,
+            "usage": usage,
+            "finish_reason": finish,
+        }
+        self.rows.append(row)
+        if association is not None:
+            await self.wait(
+                association, acknowledge=request_id not in self.pending_moves
+            )
+        return row
+
+    async def pause(self, request_id: str, predicted_seconds: float = 0.25) -> None:
+        target = self.targets.get(request_id)
+        if target is None:
+            return
+        resumed = asyncio.Event()
+        self.resume_events[request_id] = resumed
+        predicted_at = time.monotonic() + predicted_seconds
+
+        async def prepare():
+            if self.mode == "priority":
+                await self.action(
+                    "retain",
+                    {
+                        "target": target,
+                        "owner_id": target["session_id"],
+                        "declaration_id": "rollout",
+                        "priority": 50,
+                        "ttl_seconds": 30,
+                    },
+                    version="1",
+                )
+                return
+            movement_target = target
+            if self.mode != "policy":
+                message = self.pending_moves.pop(request_id, None)
+                if message is None:
+                    return
+                saved = await self.wait(message, "move")
+                blocks = [
+                    {
+                        key: row[key]
+                        for key in (
+                            "block_hash",
+                            "group_id",
+                            "start_token",
+                            "end_token",
+                        )
+                    }
+                    for row in saved.get("target_outcomes", [])
+                    if "cold_copy_stored" in row["completed_steps"]
+                ]
+                if not blocks:
+                    return
+                movement_target = {
+                    "kind": "hashes",
+                    "namespace": self.invocation["namespace"],
+                    "blocks": blocks,
+                }
+            if self.mode == "policy":
+                result = await self.action(
+                    "signal", {"target": target, "signal": "tool_wait"}, version="1"
+                )
+                if not result.get("derived_operations"):
+                    return
+                if resumed.is_set():
+                    await self.action(
+                        "signal", {"target": target, "signal": "resume"}, version="1"
+                    )
+                    return
+                submitted = asyncio.Event()

+                    "expected_revision": dict(snapshot["session_revisions"])[
+                        target["session_id"]
+                    ],
+                },
+                version="1",
+            )
+
+    async def close(self) -> None:
+        try:
+            for event in self.resume_events.values():
+                event.set()
+            if self.background:
+                await asyncio.gather(*self.background.values(), return_exceptions=True)
+            for identifier in tuple(self.targets):

+        finally:

+async def recover(args, report, restart, stop_store):

+    client = RolloutClient(base, "priority")
+    replacement = None
+    report["requests"] = client.rows
+    report["controls"] = client.controls
+    try:
+        await client.initialize()
+        report["before"] = client.invocation
+        with gzip.open(args.trace, "rt") as file:
+            prompt = json.load(file)["requests"][0]["prompt_ids"]
+        prompt = prompt[: client.boundary + 128]
+        original = await client.generate(
+            "before-restart", prompt, {"temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 16}
+        )
+        logical = client.targets["before-restart"]
+        resident = await client.call("residency", {"target": logical})
+        target = {
+            "kind": "hashes",
+            "namespace": client.invocation["namespace"],
+            "blocks": [
+                {
+                    k: row[k]
+                    for k in ("block_hash", "group_id", "start_token", "end_token")
+                }
+                for row in resident["items"]
+                if row["resident_copies"]
+            ],
+        }
+        assert target["blocks"]
+        stored = await client.action(
+            "vllm.copy_to",
+            {"target": target, "src": {"tier": "gpu"}, "dst": {"tier": "mooncake"}},
+        )
+        assert stored["status"] == "completed", stored
+        evicted = await client.action("evict", {"target": target}, version="1")
+        assert evicted["status"] == "completed", evicted
+        before = await client.call("capacity", {})
+        stop_store()

+            "submit",

+                message,
+                "vllm.copy_to",

+            ),

+        after = await client.call("capacity", {})
+        report["outage_capacity"] = after
+        assert (
+            after["transfers"]["failed_transfers"]

+        resident = await client.call("residency", {"target": target})

+def stop(process):
+    if process is None or process.poll() is not None:
+        return
+    try:
+        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
+        process.wait(timeout=45)
+    except ProcessLookupError:
+        pass
+    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
+        process.wait(timeout=15)

+    try:
+        connection = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", port), timeout=1)
+    except OSError:
+        return
+    connection.close()
+    raise RuntimeError(f"Port {port} already belongs to another process")

+def arithmetic(expression: str) -> str:
+    """Evaluate bounded arithmetic supplied by an actual model tool call."""
+    operations = {
+        ast.Add: operator.add,
+        ast.Sub: operator.sub,
+        ast.Mult: operator.mul,
+        ast.Div: operator.truediv,
+        ast.FloorDiv: operator.floordiv,
+        ast.Mod: operator.mod,
+    }
+    if len(expression) > 512:
+        raise ValueError("Expression is too long")
+
+    def visit(node):
+        if (
+            isinstance(node, ast.Constant)
+            and type(node.value) in (int, float)
+            and abs(node.value) <= 1e12
+        ):
+            return node.value
+        if isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp) and isinstance(node.op, (ast.UAdd, ast.USub)):
+            value = visit(node.operand)
+            return -value if isinstance(node.op, ast.USub) else value
+        if isinstance(node, ast.BinOp) and type(node.op) in operations:
+            value = operations[type(node.op)](visit(node.left), visit(node.right))
+            if abs(value) <= 1e15:
+                return value
+        raise ValueError("Use only numeric constants and basic arithmetic")
+
+    return str(visit(ast.parse(expression, mode="eval").body))
+

+def percentile(values, fraction):
+    if not values:
+        return None
+    values = sorted(values)
+    return values[round((len(values) - 1) * fraction)]

+    before = counters(report.get("metrics_before", ""))

+    queue_sum = after.get("vllm:request_queue_time_seconds_sum", 0) - before.get(
+        "vllm:request_queue_time_seconds_sum", 0

+"""Change real Qwen weights through CUDA IPC while old KV remains in the Store."""
+
+import argparse
+import asyncio
+import gzip
+import hashlib
+import json
+from dataclasses import asdict
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import torch
+from safetensors import safe_open
+from torch.multiprocessing.reductions import reduce_tensor
+
+from benchmarks.programmable_kv_cache.rollout import RolloutClient
+from vllm.distributed.weight_transfer.clients import HTTPVLLMWeightSyncClient
+from vllm.distributed.weight_transfer.ipc_engine import IPCWeightTransferUpdateInfo
+
+
+async def run(args):
+    client = RolloutClient(args.base_url, "priority")
+    report = {
+        "passed": False,
+        "requests": client.rows,
+        "controls": client.controls,
+        "scope": "real single-parameter IPC update and rollback; no optimizer step",
+    }
+    sync = HTTPVLLMWeightSyncClient(args.base_url)
+    with gzip.open(args.trace, "rt") as file:
+        prompt = json.load(file)["requests"][0]["prompt_ids"]
+    index = json.loads((args.model / "model.safetensors.index.json").read_text())
+    name = next(
+        n for n in index["weight_map"] if n.endswith("layers.0.input_layernorm.weight")
+    )
+    with safe_open(args.model / index["weight_map"][name], framework="pt") as file:
+        original = file.get_tensor(name)
+    changed = original + 0.125
+    report["parameter"] = name
+    report["original_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(
+        original.view(torch.uint8).numpy()
+    ).hexdigest()
+    report["changed_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(
+        changed.view(torch.uint8).numpy()
+    ).hexdigest()
+
+    async def update(tensor, version):
+        response = await client.http.post(
+            "/pause", params={"mode": "wait", "clear_cache": False}
+        )
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        await asyncio.to_thread(sync.start_weight_update)
+        copies, handles = [], {}
+        for device in range(torch.accelerator.device_count()):
+            copy = tensor.to(device=f"cuda:{device}").contiguous()
+            torch.accelerator.synchronize(device)
+            copies.append(copy)
+            handles[str(torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device).uuid)] = reduce_tensor(
+                copy
+            )[1]
+        payload = IPCWeightTransferUpdateInfo(
+            names=[name],
+            dtype_names=[str(tensor.dtype).removeprefix("torch.")],
+            shapes=[list(tensor.shape)],
+            ipc_handles=[handles],
+        )
+        await asyncio.to_thread(sync.update_weights, asdict(payload))
+        await asyncio.to_thread(sync.finish_weight_update, version)
+        response = await client.http.post("/resume")
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        await client.initialize()
+        return list(copies)
+
+    try:
+        await client.initialize()
+        before_caps = client.capabilities
+        before_version = (await client.http.get("/weight_info")).json()[
+            "weight_version"
+        ]
+        report["before_weight_version"] = before_version
+        before = await client.generate(
+            "weight-before", prompt, {"temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 32}
+        )
+        logical = client.targets["weight-before"]
+        resident = await client.call("residency", {"target": logical, "limit": 4096})
+        target = {
+            "kind": "hashes",
+            "namespace": client.invocation["namespace"],
+            "blocks": [
+                {
+                    k: row[k]
+                    for k in ("block_hash", "group_id", "start_token", "end_token")
+                }
+                for row in resident["items"]
+                if row["resident_copies"]
+            ],
+        }
+        assert target["blocks"]
+        stored = await client.action(
+            "vllm.copy_to",
+            {
+                "target": target,
+                "src": {"tier": "gpu"},
+                "dst": {"tier": "mooncake"},
+            },
+        )
+        assert stored["status"] == "completed", stored
+        old_context = dict(client.invocation)
+        await asyncio.to_thread(sync.init_weight_transfer_engine, {"packed": False})
+        refs = await update(changed, "rollout-weights-changed")
+        report["changed_capabilities"] = client.capabilities
+        assert client.invocation["namespace"] != old_context["namespace"]
+        stale = await client.http.post(
+            "/v1/kv/control",
+            json={
+                "method": "associations",
+                "invocation": old_context,
+                "payload": {},
+            },
+        )
+        assert stale.status_code == 409, stale.text
+        report["stale_epoch"] = stale.json()
+        incompatible = await client.http.post(
+            "/v1/kv/control",
+            json={
+                "method": "residency",
+                "invocation": client.invocation,
+                "payload": {"target": target},
+            },
+        )
+        assert incompatible.json()["error"]["code"] == "incompatible"
+        relabeled = dict(target, namespace=client.invocation["namespace"])
+        missing = await client.action(
+            "vllm.copy_to",
+            {
+                "target": relabeled,
+                "src": {"tier": "mooncake"},
+                "dst": {"tier": "gpu"},
+            },
+        )
+        assert missing["status"] == "missing", missing
+        changed_output = await client.generate(
+            "weight-changed", prompt, {"temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 32}
+        )
+        assert changed_output["usage"]["prompt_tokens_details"]["cached_tokens"] == 0
+        assert before["log_probs"] != changed_output["log_probs"]
+        del refs
+        refs = await update(original, before_version)
+        assert client.invocation["namespace"] == before_caps["namespace"]
+        recovered = await client.action(
+            "vllm.copy_to",
+            {
+                "target": target,
+                "src": {"tier": "mooncake"},
+                "dst": {"tier": "gpu"},
+            },
+        )
+        assert recovered["status"] == "completed", recovered
+        assert all(
+            row["transfer_id"] is not None for row in recovered["target_outcomes"]
+        )
+        restored = await client.generate(
+            "weight-restored", prompt, {"temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 32}
+        )
+        assert restored["token_ids"] == before["token_ids"]
+        assert restored["usage"]["prompt_tokens_details"]["cached_tokens"] > 0
+        report["passed"] = True
+        report["old_store_objects_survived"] = True
+        del refs
+        print(
+            json.dumps(
+                {"passed": True, "parameter": name, "old_store_objects_survived": True}
+            ),
+            flush=True,
+        )
+    except BaseException as error:
+        report["error"] = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
+        raise
+    finally:
+        await client.close()
+        args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        with gzip.open(args.output, "wt") as file:
+            json.dump(report, file)
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--base-url", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--model", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--trace", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
+    asyncio.run(run(parser.parse_args()))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
