+"""One native dispatcher for RFC primitives and the legacy semantic profile."""
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Literal, cast
+
+import msgspec
+
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.actions import (
+    PRIMITIVE_VERSION,
+    PRIMITIVES,
+    CopyTo,
+    MoveTo,
+    Primitive,
+    SetPriority,
+)
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.control import ControlError, OperationResult, OperationStatus
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.native import (
+    ActionCapability,
+    DemotePayload,
+    HashTarget,
+    NativePayload,
+    PrefetchPayload,
+    RequestTarget,
+    StorePayload,
+    Target,
+    parse_native_action,
+    validate_target,
+)
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.protocol import KvHintAction
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.state import LogicalResolution
+from vllm.v1.request import Request, RequestStatus
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.v1.kv_hints.controller import NativeKVController
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _Consumer:
+    payload_type: type[Primitive]
+    when: Callable[[Primitive], Literal["ingress", "successful_completion"]]
+
+
+def _phase(payload: Primitive) -> Literal["ingress", "successful_completion"]:
+    return (
+        "successful_completion"
+        if isinstance(payload, SetPriority) or payload.src.tier == "gpu"
+        else "ingress"
+    )
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _DeferredAction:
+    operation: OperationResult
+    payload: Primitive
+    scope: LogicalResolution | None
+    request: Request
+    generation: int
+
+
+class KvHintDispatcher:
+    def __init__(self, controller: "NativeKVController"):
+        self.controller = controller
+        self._consumers: dict[tuple[str, str], _Consumer] = {}
+        self._pending: dict[str, list[_DeferredAction]] = {}
+        for name, payload_type in PRIMITIVES.items():
+            self.register(name, PRIMITIVE_VERSION, payload_type, when=_phase)
+
+    def register(
+        self,
+        name: str,
+        version: str,
+        payload_type: type[Primitive],
+        *,
+        when: Callable[[Primitive], Literal["ingress", "successful_completion"]],
+    ) -> None:
+        key = name, version
+        if key in self._consumers:
+            raise ValueError(f"KV hint consumer already registered: {key}")
+        self._consumers[key] = _Consumer(payload_type, when)
+
+    def parse(self, action: KvHintAction) -> NativePayload | Primitive:
+        if not action.action_type.startswith("vllm."):
+            return parse_native_action(action)
+        consumer = self._consumers.get((action.action_type, action.action_version))
+        if consumer is None:
+            raise ControlError("unsupported", "Unsupported native primitive or version")
+        try:
+            payload = msgspec.convert(
+                action.payload, type=consumer.payload_type, strict=True
+            )
+        except (msgspec.ValidationError, ValueError) as error:
+            raise ControlError("invalid_payload", str(error)) from error
+        if not isinstance(payload.target, str):
+            validate_target(payload.target)
+        return payload
+
+    def lower(
+        self, payload: CopyTo | MoveTo, target: Target | str
+    ) -> DemotePayload | StorePayload | PrefetchPayload:
+        if isinstance(target, str):
+            target = HashTarget(self.controller.index.namespace, ())
+        local = self.controller.registry.engine_id
+        if any(
+            location.engine_id not in (None, local)
+            for location in (payload.src, payload.dst)
+        ):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "unsupported", "Remote engines must approve their own COPY"
+            )
+        src, dst = payload.src.tier, payload.dst.tier
+        if src == "gpu" and dst in ("cpu", "mooncake"):
+            cls = DemotePayload if isinstance(payload, MoveTo) else StorePayload
+            return cls(target, cast(Literal["cpu", "mooncake"], dst))
+        if src in ("cpu", "mooncake") and dst == "gpu" and isinstance(payload, CopyTo):
+            return PrefetchPayload(target, cast(Literal["cpu", "mooncake"], src))
+        raise ControlError(
+            "unsupported",
+            "Requires local G1/cold COPY or G1-to-cold MOVE; "
+            "cold deletion is unsupported",
+        )
+
+    def execute(
+        self,
+        operation: OperationResult,
+        payload: Primitive,
+        *,
+        request_id: str | None,
+        resolution: LogicalResolution | None,
+        attached: bool,
+        owners: tuple[str, ...] = (),
+    ) -> None:
+        executor = self.controller.executor
+        if executor is None:
+            raise ControlError("unsupported", "No primitive executor configured")
+        consumer = self._consumers[(operation.action_type, operation.action_version)]
+        if isinstance(payload, (CopyTo, MoveTo)):
+            lowered = self.lower(payload, payload.target)
+            kind, tier = (
+                ("prefetch", lowered.source)
+                if isinstance(lowered, PrefetchPayload)
+                else ("demote", lowered.destination)
+            )
+            if not any(
+                c.action_type == kind and tier in c.tiers
+                for c in executor.capabilities()
+            ):
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "unsupported",
+                    "No adapter supports the requested primitive direction",
+                )
+        if attached and consumer.when(payload) == "successful_completion":
+            observer = self.controller.request_observer
+            if observer is None:
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "unsupported", "Request lifecycle binding is unavailable"
+                )
+            request = observer.request(RequestTarget("$request"), request_id)
+            pending = self._pending.get(request.request_id)
+            if pending and pending[0].request is not request:
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "busy", "Request ID is already bound to another lifecycle"
+                )
+            if isinstance(
+                payload.target, RequestTarget
+            ) and payload.target.request_id not in ("$request", request.request_id):
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "unsupported",
+                    "Deferred request selectors must name the bound request",
+                )
+            scope = resolution
+            if scope is None and not isinstance(payload.target, (str, RequestTarget)):
+                scope = self.controller.index.resolve(payload.target)
+                executor.validate_scope(scope)
+            # Pending actions share the bounded registry admission.
+            work = _DeferredAction(
+                operation,
+                payload,
+                scope,
+                request,
+                executor.manager.get_transfer_manager().generation,
+            )
+            self._pending.setdefault(request.request_id, []).append(work)
+            self.controller.registry.update(
+                operation,
+                OperationStatus.QUEUED,
+                reason="Awaiting successful request completion",
+            )
+            return
+        self._execute_now(
+            operation, payload, resolution, request_id=request_id, owners=owners
+        )
+
+    def _execute_now(
+        self,
+        operation: OperationResult,
+        payload: Primitive,
+        scope: LogicalResolution | None,
+        *,
+        request_id: str | None = None,
+        request: Request | None = None,
+        owners: tuple[str, ...] = (),
+    ) -> None:
+        controller = self.controller
+        executor = controller.executor
+        assert executor is not None
+        if scope is None:
+            if request is not None and isinstance(payload.target, RequestTarget):
+                observer = controller.request_observer
+                assert observer is not None
+                scope = controller.index.resolve(
+                    observer.resolve_finished(request, payload.target)
+                )
+            elif request is not None and isinstance(payload.target, str):
+                scope = executor.request_scope(request, payload.target)
+            elif payload.target == "request_cached":
+                if request_id is None or controller.request_observer is None:
+                    raise ControlError(
+                        "unsupported", "request_cached requires a bound request"
+                    )
+                request = controller.request_observer.request(
+                    RequestTarget("$request"), request_id
+                )
+                scope = executor.request_scope(request, "request_cached")
+            else:
+                assert not isinstance(payload.target, str)
+                scope = controller.index.resolve(
+                    controller._target(payload.target, request_id)
+                )
+        executor.validate_scope(scope)
+        if payload.target == "request_cached" and not any(
+            p.blocks for p in scope.prefixes
+        ):
+            raise ControlError("missing", "No cached copies held by the bound request")
+        if isinstance(payload, SetPriority):
+            if (
+                controller.policies is not None
+                and operation.origin is None
+                and payload.value is not None
+            ):
+                controller.policies.before_explicit(payload, scope)
+            executor.apply_priority(operation, payload, scope, request, owners)
+            return
+        # The logical snapshot is authoritative; lowering does not resolve it again.
+        target = HashTarget(
+            scope.namespace,
+            tuple(b for p in scope.prefixes for b in p.blocks),
+            scope.start_token,
+            scope.end_token,
+        )
+        lowered = self.lower(payload, target)
+        if controller.policies is not None and operation.origin is None:
+            controller.policies.before_explicit(lowered, scope)
+        executor.submit(operation, lowered, scope)
+
+    def finish(self, request: Request) -> None:
+        pending = self._pending.pop(request.request_id, ())
+        for work in pending:
+            try:
+                if work.request is not request or request.status not in (
+                    RequestStatus.FINISHED_STOPPED,
+                    RequestStatus.FINISHED_LENGTH_CAPPED,
+                ):
+                    self.controller.registry.update(
+                        work.operation,
+                        OperationStatus.CANCELLED,
+                        reason="Request did not finish successfully",
+                    )
+                    continue
+                executor = self.controller.executor
+                assert executor is not None
+                if (
+                    executor.manager.get_transfer_manager().generation
+                    != work.generation
+                ):
+                    self.controller.registry.update(
+                        work.operation,
+                        OperationStatus.CANCELLED,
+                        reason="Cache reset invalidated the queued action",
+                    )
+                    continue
+                self._execute_now(
+                    work.operation, work.payload, work.scope, request=request
+                )
+            except ControlError as error:
+                self.controller.record_error(work.operation, error)
+            except Exception as error:
+                self.controller._record_failure(
+                    work.operation, OperationStatus.FAILED, type(error).__name__
+                )
+
+    def cancel(self, operation_id: int) -> None:
+        for request_id, works in tuple(self._pending.items()):
+            remaining = [w for w in works if w.operation.operation_id != operation_id]
+            if remaining:
+                self._pending[request_id] = remaining
+            else:
+                del self._pending[request_id]
+
+    def capabilities(self) -> tuple[ActionCapability, ...]:
+        executor = self.controller.executor
+        if executor is None:
+            return ()
+        targets: tuple[
+            Literal["hashes", "session", "request", "request_cached"], ...
+        ] = (
+            ("hashes", "session", "request", "request_cached")
+            if self.controller.request_observer is not None
+            else ("hashes", "session")
+        )
+        result = [
+            ActionCapability(
+                "vllm.set_priority",
+                PRIMITIVE_VERSION,
+                targets,
+                ("gpu",),
+                True,
+                (
+                    "Copy-lifetime claims; attached actions apply at "
+                    "successful completion",
+                    "request_cached requires a request binding",
+                ),
+            )
+        ]
+        for kind in ("vllm.copy_to", "vllm.move_to"):
+            selected = [
+                c
+                for c in executor.capabilities()
+                if c.action_type == "demote"
+                or (kind == "vllm.copy_to" and c.action_type == "prefetch")
+            ]
+            if not selected:
+                continue
+            tiers = tuple(dict.fromkeys(t for c in selected for t in c.tiers))
+            directions = tuple(
+                dict.fromkeys(
+                    (f"{tier}->gpu" if c.action_type == "prefetch" else f"gpu->{tier}")
+                    for c in selected
+                    for tier in c.tiers
+                    if tier != "gpu"
+                )
+            )
+            limitations = tuple(
+                dict.fromkeys(note for c in selected for note in c.limitations)
+            ) + (
+                "Attached GPU sources execute at successful completion; "
+                "cold COPY at ingress",
+                "No remote G1 allocation or cold-tier deletion",
+            )
+            result.append(
+                ActionCapability(
+                    kind,
+                    PRIMITIVE_VERSION,
+                    targets,
+                    tiers,
+                    True,
+                    limitations,
+                    directions,
+                )
+            )
+        return tuple(result)

+"""Construct the optional control runtime from the initialized engine profile."""
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import uuid
+from collections.abc import Callable, Iterable
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_manager import KVCacheManager
+from vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_utils import get_none_hash_seed
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.api import KVControlService
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.control import OperationRegistry
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.controller import NativeKVController
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.request_observer import RequestContinuationObserver
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.resources import KVResourceController

+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.state import SessionPrefixIndex

+    from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.base import KVConnectorBase_V1
+

+def create_control_service(
+    config: VllmConfig,
+    manager: KVCacheManager,
+    weight_version: str,
+    *,
+    request_lookup: Callable[[str], Request | None] | None = None,
+    connector: "KVConnectorBase_V1 | None" = None,
+    transfer_allowed: Callable[[], bool] | None = None,
+    requests: Callable[[], Iterable[Request]] | None = None,
+    previous: KVControlService | None = None,
+) -> KVControlService:
+    settings = config.kv_control_config
+    assert settings is not None
+    manager.block_pool.track_cached_block_counts()
+    manager.get_transfer_manager().max_load_blocks = settings.max_inflight_load_blocks
+    if not manager.enable_caching:
+        raise ValueError("Programmable KV control requires prefix caching")
+    engine_id = settings.engine_id or uuid.uuid4().hex
+    if config.parallel_config.data_parallel_size > 1:
+        engine_id += f":dp{config.parallel_config.data_parallel_rank}"
+    if previous is not None:
+        engine_id = previous.controller.registry.engine_id
+    profile = {
+        "model": config.model_config.compute_hash(),
+        "cache": config.cache_config.compute_hash(),
+        "hash_algorithm": config.cache_config.prefix_caching_hash_algo,
+        "hash_block_size": manager.block_pool.hash_block_size,
+        "hash_seed": get_none_hash_seed(),
+        "layout": config.cache_config.kv_cache_layout,
+        "parallel": (
+            config.parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size,
+            config.parallel_config.pipeline_parallel_size,
+            config.parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size,
+            config.parallel_config.prefill_context_parallel_size,
+        ),
+        "groups": [
+            (
+                tuple(group.layer_names),
+                repr(group.kv_cache_spec),
+                group_manager.block_size,
+            )
+            for group, group_manager in zip(
+                manager.kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups,
+                manager.coordinator.single_type_managers,
+                strict=True,
+            )
+        ],
+        "weight_version": weight_version,
+    }
+    namespace = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(profile, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
+    registry = OperationRegistry(
+        engine_id,
+        max_records=settings.max_records,
+        max_acknowledged_messages=settings.max_acknowledged_messages,
+        max_actions=settings.max_actions,
+        max_envelope_bytes=settings.max_envelope_bytes,
+        max_events=settings.max_events,
+        max_result_targets=settings.max_result_targets,
+        result_ttl=settings.result_ttl,
+    )
+    index = SessionPrefixIndex(
+        namespace,
+        registry.engine_epoch,
+        max_sessions=settings.max_sessions,
+        max_continuations=settings.max_continuations,
+        max_associations=settings.max_associations,
+        max_events=settings.max_events,
+        max_tombstones=settings.max_tombstones,
+    )
+    declarations = RetentionDeclarations(
+        index,
+        max_declarations=settings.max_declarations,
+        max_snapshot_entries=settings.max_snapshot_entries,
+    )
+    adapters = connector.create_kv_control_adapters() if connector is not None else ()
+    if previous is None:
+        executor = KVResourceController(
+            manager, registry, declarations, adapters, transfer_allowed
+        )
+    else:
+        previous_executor = previous.controller.executor
+        assert isinstance(previous_executor, KVResourceController)
+        executor = previous_executor
+        executor.rebind(registry, declarations, adapters)
+    cache_profile = {
+        "weight_version": weight_version,
+        "request_cache_salt_prefix": None if weight_version == "default" else namespace,
+        "request_cache_salt_encoding": "compact UTF-8 JSON [prefix, original_salt]",
+        "queries": ("operation", "associations", "events", "residency", "capacity"),
+        "acknowledge": "Terminal messages only; replay guards keep original TTL",
+        "cancel": "One action incarnation; worker holds drain before reuse",
+        "residency_tiers": ("gpu",),
+        "hash_algorithm": profile["hash_algorithm"],
+        "hash_block_size": profile["hash_block_size"],
+        "hash_seed": profile["hash_seed"],
+        "groups": [
+            {
+                "group_id": group_id,
+                "block_size": group_manager.block_size,
+                "prefix_cacheable": group.kv_cache_spec.prefix_cacheable,
+            }
+            for group_id, (group, group_manager) in enumerate(
+                zip(
+                    manager.kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups,
+                    manager.coordinator.single_type_managers,
+                    strict=True,
+                )
+            )
+        ],
+    }
+    observer = None
+    if request_lookup is not None and not getattr(
+        config.model_config, "is_diffusion", False
+    ):
+        observer = RequestContinuationObserver(index, manager, request_lookup)
+        cache_profile["request_limitations"] = (
+            "Finite text-token requests; no LoRA, multimodal, "
+            "prompt embeddings or resumable input"
+        )
+    controller = NativeKVController(
+        registry,
+        index,
+        declarations,
+        executor=executor,
+        cache_profile=cache_profile,
+        request_resolver=observer.resolve if observer is not None else None,
+        request_observer=observer,
+    )
+    if settings.policies:
+        from vllm.v1.kv_hints.policy_runtime import KVPolicyRuntime
+
+        controller.policies = KVPolicyRuntime(
+            settings, controller, manager, requests or (lambda: ())
+        )
+        cache_profile["policies"] = tuple(controller.policies.policies)
+    return KVControlService(controller)

+            return
+        self._last_tick = now
+        self._reap()
+        registry = self.controller.registry
+        for work in tuple(self._pending.values()):
+            if work.generation != self._generation():
+                self._cancel(work, "Cache reset invalidated the policy plan")
+        ready = [w for w in self._pending.values() if w.proposal.not_before <= now]
+        copies: dict[int, list[_Work]] = {}
+        for candidate in (*self._pending.values(), *self._running.values()):
+            if (
+                isinstance(candidate.proposal.action, CopyTo)
+                and candidate.proposal.action.dst.tier == "gpu"
+                and candidate.operation.origin is not None
+            ):

+                    candidate
+                )

+                assert origin is not None

+                    (
+                        other.operation.operation_id in self._pending
+                        or other.operation.operation_id in self._running
+                    )
+                    and work.proposal.content_keys.intersection(
+                        other.proposal.content_keys
+                    )
+                    for other in copies.get(origin.operation_id, ())
+                )
+                if waiting_for_copy:
+                    registry.update(
+                        work.operation,
+                        OperationStatus.QUEUED,
+                        reason="Awaiting compatible policy COPY",
+                    )

+            del self._pending[work.operation.operation_id]
+            executed += 1
+            work.started_at = now
+            conflict = False
+            if work.scope is not None:
+                executor = self.controller.executor
+                conflict = executor is not None and executor.conflicts_with_explicit(
+                    action, work.scope
+                )
+                if isinstance(action, (DemotePayload, MoveTo, EvictPayload)):
+                    for (
+                        declaration
+                    ) in self.controller.declarations.active_declarations():
+                        if (
+                            declaration.policy_name is None
+                            and work.proposal.content_keys.intersection(
+                                _keys(
+                                    self.controller.declarations.coverage(
+                                        declaration.owner_id, declaration.declaration_id
+                                    )
+                                )
+                            )
+                        ):
+                            conflict = True
+                            break
+            if conflict:
+                registry.update(
+                    work.operation,
+                    OperationStatus.DEFERRED,
+                    reason="Explicit command takes precedence",
+                )
+            else:
+                self.controller.execute_registered(
+                    work.operation,
+                    action,
+                    resolution=work.scope,
+                    policy_owners=work.owners,
+                )
+            result = registry.get(work.operation.message_id, work.operation.action_id)
+            if (
+                isinstance(action, RetainPayload)
+                and result is not None
+                and result.status
+                in (OperationStatus.COMPLETED, OperationStatus.PARTIAL)

+                owners=work.owners,
+                elapsed_seconds=max(0.0, self.clock() - work.started_at),

+        self._reap()
+
+    def cancel_operation(self, operation_id: int) -> None:
+        work = self._pending.get(operation_id) or self._running.get(operation_id)
+        if work is not None:
+            self._cancel(work, "Caller cancelled the operation")
+
+    def _reap(self) -> None:
+        registry = self.controller.registry
+        for identifier, work in tuple(self._running.items()):
+            current = registry.get(work.operation.message_id, work.operation.action_id)

+                    self._notify_result(work, current)
+                del self._running[identifier]
+                self._target_entries -= work.entries
+        if self._declaration_owners:
+            active_owners = {
+                d.owner_id for d in self.controller.declarations.active_declarations()
+            }
+            self._declaration_owners = {
+                key: value
+                for key, value in self._declaration_owners.items()
+                if key in active_owners
+            }

+"""Observe explicit request associations without treating them as GPU ownership."""
+
+import hashlib
+import struct
+from collections.abc import Callable, Iterator
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any
+
+import msgspec
+
+from vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_manager import KVCacheManager
+from vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_utils import make_block_hash_with_group_id
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.control import ControlError
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.native import (
+    AssociatePayload,
+    ContentSpan,
+    HashTarget,
+    RequestTarget,
+)
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.state import (
+    ContinuationKey,
+    ContinuationState,
+    SessionPrefixIndex,
+    TokenPrefixCheckpoint,
+)
+from vllm.v1.request import Request
+
+
+def _token_bytes(request: Request, start: int, end: int) -> bytes:
+    return struct.pack(f"<{end - start}Q", *request.all_token_ids[start:end])
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _Binding:
+    request: Request
+    target: RequestTarget
+    incarnation: int
+    count: int
+    hash_count: int
+    computed_count: int
+    token_hasher: Any
+
+
+class RequestContinuationObserver:
+    """A bounded request-to-continuation subscription, backed by the shared index."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        index: SessionPrefixIndex,
+        manager: KVCacheManager,
+        lookup: Callable[[str], Request | None],
+    ):
+        self.index = index
+        self.manager = manager
+        self.lookup = lookup
+        self._attached: dict[str, Request] = {}
+        self._bindings: dict[ContinuationKey, _Binding] = {}
+
+    @contextmanager
+    def attach(self, request: Request) -> Iterator[None]:
+        self._attached[request.request_id] = request
+        try:
+            yield
+        finally:
+            del self._attached[request.request_id]
+
+    def request(self, target: RequestTarget, request_id: str | None) -> Request:
+        identity = request_id if target.request_id == "$request" else target.request_id
+        request = (
+            None
+            if identity is None
+            else self._attached.get(identity) or self.lookup(identity)
+        )
+        if request is None or request.is_finished():
+            raise ControlError("missing", "Request is not active on this engine")
+        if (
+            request.prompt_embeds is not None
+            or request.mm_features
+            or request.lora_request is not None
+            or request.resumable
+        ):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "unsupported",
+                "Request targeting requires a finite text-token request without LoRA",
+            )
+        return request
+
+    def resolve(self, target: RequestTarget, request_id: str | None) -> HashTarget:
+        request = self.request(target, request_id)
+        return self._resolve(request, target)
+
+    def resolve_finished(self, request: Request, target: RequestTarget) -> HashTarget:
+        """Resolve completed token content, including detached cached checkpoints."""
+        if not request.is_finished():
+            raise ControlError(
+                "invalid_payload", "Completion scope requires a finished request"
+            )
+        return self._resolve(request, target)
+
+    def session_for(self, target: RequestTarget, request_id: str | None) -> str | None:
+        return self.request(target, request_id).session_id
+
+    def _resolve(self, request: Request, target: RequestTarget) -> HashTarget:
+        end = request.num_tokens if target.end_token is None else target.end_token
+        if end > request.num_tokens or target.start_token >= end:
+            raise ControlError("missing", "Request range is not yet observed")
+        unit = self.manager.block_pool.hash_block_size
+        cached = self.manager.block_pool.cached_block_hash_to_block
+        blocks = []
+        for group_id, group_manager in enumerate(
+            self.manager.coordinator.single_type_managers
+        ):
+            spec = self.manager.kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups[group_id].kv_cache_spec
+            if not spec.prefix_cacheable:
+                continue
+            size = group_manager.block_size
+            for hash_index, block_hash in enumerate(
+                request.block_hashes[: end // unit]
+            ):
+                position = (hash_index + 1) * unit
+                start = (position - 1) // size * size
+                if position <= target.start_token:
+                    continue
+                if position % size and not cached.get_blocks(
+                    make_block_hash_with_group_id(block_hash, group_id)
+                ):
+                    continue
+                blocks.append(ContentSpan(block_hash.hex(), group_id, start, position))
+                if len(blocks) > self.index.max_associations:
+                    raise ControlError(
+                        "capacity", "Request target exceeds logical index capacity"
+                    )
+        return HashTarget(self.index.namespace, tuple(blocks), target.start_token, end)
+
+    def associate(
+        self,
+        payload: AssociatePayload,
+        request_id: str | None,
+        blocks: tuple[ContentSpan, ...],
+    ) -> None:
+        key = payload.session_id, payload.continuation_id
+        try:
+            previous = self.index.get(*key)
+        except ControlError:
+            previous = None
+        revision = 0 if previous is None else previous.revision
+        if payload.expected_revision != revision:
+            raise ControlError(
+                "stale_revision", f"Expected current revision {revision}"
+            )
+        binding = self._bindings.get(key)
+        if not isinstance(payload.target, RequestTarget):
+            if binding is not None:
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "busy", "Continuation is observing an active request"
+                )
+            self.index.associate(
+                *key,
+                blocks,
+                expected_revision=payload.expected_revision,
+                task_parent_id=payload.task_parent_id,
+                parent_prefix=payload.parent_prefix,
+            )
+            return
+        request = self.request(payload.target, request_id)
+        if binding is not None and binding.request is not request:
+            raise ControlError(
+                "busy", "Use a new continuation for a concurrent request"
+            )
+        count = (
+            request.num_tokens
+            if payload.target.end_token is None
+            else payload.target.end_token
+        )
+        context = hashlib.sha256(msgspec.json.encode((request.cache_salt,))).hexdigest()
+        if previous is None and payload.parent_prefix is not None:
+            parent = self.index.get(
+                payload.parent_prefix.session_id, payload.parent_prefix.continuation_id
+            )
+            inherited = tuple(
+                b
+                for b in parent.blocks
+                if b.end_token <= payload.parent_prefix.end_token
+            )
+            self._check_content(request, inherited)
+            if (
+                not any(
+                    b.end_token == payload.parent_prefix.end_token for b in inherited
+                )
+                and payload.parent_prefix.end_token
+            ):
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "unsupported",
+                    "Parent boundary has no verifiable content checkpoint",
+                )
+        if previous is not None:
+            old = previous.checkpoint
+            if old is not None:
+                if (
+                    request.num_tokens < old.token_count
+                    or context != old.context_digest
+                    or hashlib.sha256(
+                        _token_bytes(request, 0, old.token_count)
+                    ).hexdigest()
+                    != old.token_digest
+                ):
+                    raise ControlError(
+                        "conflict",
+                        "Request rewrites the token prefix; use a new continuation ID",
+                    )
+                count = max(count, old.token_count)
+            self._check_content(request, previous.blocks)
+            blocks = tuple(set(previous.blocks) | set(blocks))
+        hasher = hashlib.sha256(_token_bytes(request, 0, count))
+        checkpoint = TokenPrefixCheckpoint(count, hasher.hexdigest(), context)
+        state = self.index.associate(
+            *key,
+            blocks,
+            expected_revision=payload.expected_revision,
+            task_parent_id=payload.task_parent_id,
+            parent_prefix=payload.parent_prefix,
+            checkpoint=checkpoint,
+        )
+        if payload.observe_growth:
+            hash_count, computed_count = self._hash_counts(request, payload.target)
+            self._bindings[key] = _Binding(
+                request,
+                payload.target,
+                state.incarnation,
+                count,
+                hash_count,
+                computed_count,
+                hasher,
+            )
+        else:
+            self._bindings.pop(key, None)
+
+    def _hash_counts(self, request: Request, target: RequestTarget) -> tuple[int, int]:
+        end = (
+            request.num_tokens
+            if target.end_token is None
+            else min(request.num_tokens, target.end_token)
+        )
+        unit = self.manager.block_pool.hash_block_size
+        known = min(len(request.block_hashes), end // unit)
+        completed = (
+            max(0, request.num_computed_tokens - request.num_in_flight_tokens) // unit
+        )
+        return known, min(known, completed)
+
+    def _check_content(self, request: Request, blocks: tuple[ContentSpan, ...]) -> None:
+        unit = self.manager.block_pool.hash_block_size
+        for block in blocks:
+            index = block.end_token // unit - 1
+            if (
+                block.end_token % unit
+                or not 0 <= index < len(request.block_hashes)
+                or request.block_hashes[index].hex() != block.block_hash
+            ):
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "conflict", "Request changes previously associated content"
+                )
+
+    def observe(self) -> None:
+        for key, binding in tuple(self._bindings.items()):
+            try:
+                state = self.index.get(*key)
+            except ControlError:
+                del self._bindings[key]
+                continue
+            if state.incarnation != binding.incarnation:
+                del self._bindings[key]
+                continue
+            request = binding.request
+            count = request.num_tokens
+            if binding.target.end_token is not None:
+                count = min(count, binding.target.end_token)
+            try:
+                if request.num_tokens < binding.count:
+                    raise ControlError(
+                        "conflict", "Observed request truncated its token prefix"
+                    )
+                assert state.checkpoint is not None
+                count = max(count, state.checkpoint.token_count)
+                hash_count, computed_count = self._hash_counts(request, binding.target)
+                refresh = (hash_count, computed_count) != (
+                    binding.hash_count,
+                    binding.computed_count,
+                )
+                if count != binding.count or refresh or request.is_finished():
+                    binding.token_hasher.update(
+                        _token_bytes(request, binding.count, count)
+                    )
+                    blocks = state.blocks
+                    if refresh or request.is_finished():
+                        blocks = self._growth_blocks(binding, state)
+                    self.index.associate(
+                        *key,
+                        blocks,
+                        expected_revision=state.revision,
+                        parent_prefix=state.parent_prefix,
+                        checkpoint=TokenPrefixCheckpoint(
+                            count,
+                            binding.token_hasher.hexdigest(),
+                            state.checkpoint.context_digest,
+                        ),
+                    )
+                    binding.count, binding.hash_count, binding.computed_count = (
+                        count,
+                        hash_count,
+                        computed_count,
+                    )
+            except ControlError as error:
+                self.index.report_observation_failure(
+                    *key, reason=f"{request.request_id}: {error.code}: {error}"
+                )
+                del self._bindings[key]
+                continue
+            if request.is_finished():
+                del self._bindings[key]
+
+    def _growth_blocks(
+        self, binding: _Binding, state: ContinuationState
+    ) -> tuple[ContentSpan, ...]:
+        request = binding.request
+        self._check_content(request, state.blocks)
+        blocks = set(state.blocks)
+        blocks.update(self._resolve(request, binding.target).blocks)
+        if blocks == set(state.blocks):
+            return state.blocks
+        return tuple(blocks)

+"""Engine-side resource integration for programmable cache operations."""
+
+import time
+from collections.abc import Callable

+class KVRetentionPriority:
+    """Project declaration changes into the existing pool's eviction ordering."""
+
+    def __init__(self, pool: BlockPool, declarations: RetentionDeclarations):
+        self.declarations = declarations
+        self.pool = pool
+        self.copies = KVCachePriority()
+        self._version: tuple[int, int] | None = None
+        self._priorities: dict[BlockHashWithGroupId, int] = {}
+        self.synchronize()
+        pool.configure_retention(
+            self.priority,
+            self.synchronize,
+            copy_priority=self.copies.priority,
+            forget_priority=self.copies.forget,
+        )
+
+    def priority(self, key: BlockHashWithGroupId) -> int | None:
+        return self._priorities.get(key)
+
+    def synchronize(self) -> tuple[BlockHashWithGroupId, ...]:
+        changed_copies = self.copies.take_changes()
+        if self.pool._retention_queue is not None:
+            for block_id in changed_copies:
+                self.pool._retention_queue.cache_changed(self.pool.blocks[block_id])
+        version, snapshot = self.declarations.priority_snapshot()
+        if version == self._version:
+            return ()
+        updated = {
+            make_block_hash_with_group_id(
+                BlockHash(bytes.fromhex(block_hash)), group
+            ): p
+            for (group, block_hash), p in snapshot.items()
+        }
+        changed = tuple(
+            key
+            for key in self._priorities.keys() | updated.keys()
+            if self._priorities.get(key) != updated.get(key)
+        )
+        self._priorities = updated
+        self._version = version
+        return changed
+
+
+class KVResourceController:
+    """Approve physical work against the existing KV manager and block pool."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        manager: KVCacheManager,
+        registry: OperationRegistry,
+        declarations: RetentionDeclarations,
+        adapters: tuple[KVTransferAdapter, ...] = (),
+        transfer_allowed: Callable[[], bool] | None = None,
+    ):
+        self.manager = manager
+        self.registry = registry
+        self.declarations = declarations
+        self.pool = manager.block_pool
+        self.transfer_allowed = transfer_allowed
+        self.retention_priority = KVRetentionPriority(self.pool, declarations)
+        self.transfers = (
+            KVTransferOperations(
+                manager, registry, declarations.index.namespace, adapters
+            )
+            if adapters
+            else None
+        )
+
+    def rebind(
+        self,
+        registry: OperationRegistry,
+        declarations: RetentionDeclarations,
+        adapters: tuple[KVTransferAdapter, ...],
+    ) -> None:
+        """Replace weight-scoped state after idle cache invalidation."""
+        if self.has_pending or self.manager.get_transfer_manager().has_pending:
+            raise ControlError("busy", "Transfers must drain before namespace change")
+        self.registry = registry
+        self.declarations = declarations
+        self.retention_priority.declarations = declarations
+        self.retention_priority._version = None
+        for block in self.pool.blocks:
+            self.retention_priority.copies.forget(block)
+        self.retention_priority.synchronize()
+        self.transfers = (
+            KVTransferOperations(
+                self.manager, registry, declarations.index.namespace, adapters
+            )
+            if adapters
+            else None
+        )
+
+    def capabilities(self) -> tuple[ActionCapability, ...]:
+        local = (
+            ActionCapability(
+                "evict",
+                NATIVE_ACTION_VERSION,
+                ("hashes", "session"),
+                ("gpu",),
+                True,
+                ("Referenced copies and unaddressed aliases are preserved",),
+            ),
+        )
+        if self.transfers is None:
+            return local
+        return local + tuple(
+            ActionCapability(
+                action,
+                NATIVE_ACTION_VERSION,
+                ("hashes", "session"),
+                ("gpu", adapter.tier),
+                True,
+                adapter.limitations,
+            )
+            for adapter in self.transfers.adapters.values()
+            for action in adapter.actions
+        )
+
+    def validate_scope(self, target: LogicalResolution) -> None:
+        if target.namespace != self.declarations.index.namespace:
+            raise ControlError(
+                "incompatible", "Target belongs to another cache namespace"
+            )
+        if target.start_token > self.manager.max_model_len or (
+            target.end_token is not None
+            and target.end_token > self.manager.max_model_len
+        ):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "invalid_payload", "Target exceeds the engine context limit"
+            )
+        for prefix in target.prefixes:
+            for block in (*prefix.blocks, *prefix.partial_blocks):
+                if not 0 <= block.group_id < self.manager.num_kv_cache_groups:
+                    raise ControlError("unsupported", "Cache group is not configured")
+                spec = self.manager.kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups[
+                    block.group_id
+                ].kv_cache_spec
+                if not spec.prefix_cacheable:
+                    raise ControlError(
+                        "unsupported", "Cache group has no reusable prefix entries"
+                    )
+                if block.end_token > self.manager.max_model_len:
+                    raise ControlError(
+                        "invalid_payload", "Content exceeds the engine context limit"
+                    )
+                block_size = self.manager.coordinator.single_type_managers[
+                    block.group_id
+                ].block_size
+                if (
+                    block.end_token % self.pool.hash_block_size
+                    or block.start_token
+                    != ((block.end_token - 1) // block_size) * block_size
+                ):
+                    raise ControlError(
+                        "unsupported", "Content does not match a cache-group boundary"
+                    )
+                key = make_block_hash_with_group_id(
+                    BlockHash(bytes.fromhex(block.block_hash)), block.group_id
+                )
+                for copy in self.pool.cached_block_hash_to_block.get_blocks(key):
+                    if (
+                        copy.block_hash == key
+                        and copy.block_hash_num_tokens != block.end_token
+                    ):
+                        raise ControlError(
+                            "invalid_payload",
+                            "Content coordinates disagree with the cached copy",
+                        )

+                    if cursor < end_token:
+                        gaps.append(RangeGap(group, cursor, end_token))
+            prefixes.append(
+                ResolvedPrefix(key, revision, tuple(full), tuple(partial), tuple(gaps))
+            )
+        return LogicalResolution(
+            self.namespace, target.start_token, target.end_token, tuple(prefixes)
+        )
+
+    def query(
+        self,
+        *,
+        session_id: str | None = None,
+        after: ContinuationKey | None = None,
+        revision: int | None = None,
+        limit: int = 256,
+    ) -> AssociationPage:
+        if type(limit) is not int or not 1 <= limit <= 4096:
+            raise ValueError("Query limit must be between 1 and 4096")
+        if revision is not None and revision != self.revision:
+            raise ControlError("stale_revision", "Index changed; restart pagination")
+        if after is not None and revision is None:
+            raise ControlError(
+                "invalid_cursor", "Pagination requires an index revision"
+            )
+        if session_id is not None:
+            self.session_revision(session_id)
+        keys = [
+            key
+            for key in sorted(self._continuations)
+            if (session_id is None or key[0] == session_id)
+            and (after is None or key > after)
+        ]
+        selected = keys[:limit]
+        cursor = selected[-1] if len(keys) > limit else None
+        return AssociationPage(
+            self.revision,
+            tuple(self._continuations[k] for k in selected),
+            cursor,
+            self.engine_epoch,
+            self.namespace,
+            self._sequence,
+            tuple(
+                (name, self._sessions[name].revision)
+                for name in sorted({key[0] for key in selected})
+            ),
+        )
+
+    def task_tree(self, session_id: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+        self.session_revision(session_id)
+        children: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+        for name, session in self._sessions.items():
+            if session.parent is not None:
+                children.setdefault(session.parent, []).append(name)
+        todo = [session_id]
+        result = []
+        while todo:
+            name = todo.pop()
+            result.append(name)
+            todo.extend(children.get(name, ()))
+        return tuple(result)
+
+    def finish_task(
+        self, session_id: str, *, expected_revision: int
+    ) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+        """Remove logical state; the controller must drain operation interests."""
+        self._check_revision(expected_revision, self.session_revision(session_id))
+        removed = self.task_tree(session_id)
+        selected = set(removed)
+        self.revision += 1
+        self._touch_ancestors(session_id)
+        for key in tuple(self._continuations):
+            if key[0] in selected:
+                self._remove(key, "finished")
+        for name in removed:
+            del self._sessions[name]
+        return removed
+
+    def prune(
+        self, session_id: str, continuation_id: str, *, expected_revision: int
+    ) -> None:
+        """Forget selected history after the caller checks active interests."""
+        state = self.get(session_id, continuation_id)
+        self._check_revision(expected_revision, state.revision)
+        self.revision += 1
+        self._remove((session_id, continuation_id), "pruned")
+        self._touch_ancestors(session_id)
+
+    def events(
+        self, after: int, *, epoch: str, limit: int = 256
+    ) -> tuple[AssociationEvent, ...]:
+        if epoch != self.engine_epoch:
+            raise ControlError(
+                "stale_epoch", "Association events belong to another epoch"
+            )
+        if type(limit) is not int or not 1 <= limit <= 4096:
+            raise ValueError("Event limit must be between 1 and 4096")
+        if type(after) is not int or not 0 <= after <= self._sequence:
+            raise ControlError("event_gap", "Invalid association event position")
+        if self._events and after < self._events[0].sequence - 1:
+            raise ControlError(
+                "event_gap", "Association history was pruned; query state"
+            )
+        return tuple(islice((e for e in self._events if e.sequence > after), limit))
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _check_revision(expected: int, actual: int) -> None:
+        if type(expected) is not int or expected != actual:
+            raise ControlError("stale_revision", f"Expected current revision {actual}")
+
+    def _emit(
+        self,
+        key: ContinuationKey,
+        kind: Literal[
+            "associated",
+            "removed",
+            "updated",
+            "pruned",
+            "finished",
+            "observation_failed",
+        ],
+        content: ContentSpan | None = None,
+        reason: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        self._sequence += 1
+        self._events.append(
+            AssociationEvent(
+                self.engine_epoch,
+                self._sequence,
+                self.revision,
+                *key,
+                kind,
+                content,
+                reason,
+            )
+        )
+
+    def _remove(
+        self, key: ContinuationKey, reason: Literal["pruned", "finished"]
+    ) -> None:
+        state = self._continuations.pop(key)
+        self.content_revision = self.revision
+        self._association_count -= len(state.blocks)
+        for content in {content_key(block) for block in state.blocks}:
+            members = self._members[content]
+            members.pop(key, None)
+            if not members:
+                del self._members[content]
+        for block in state.blocks:
+            self._emit(key, "removed", block)
+        self._tombstones[key] = reason
+        self._tombstones.move_to_end(key)
+        while len(self._tombstones) > self.max_tombstones:
+            self._tombstones.popitem(last=False)
+        self._emit(key, reason)
+
+    def _touch_ancestors(self, session_id: str) -> None:
+        current: str | None = session_id
+        while current is not None:
+            session = self._sessions[current]
+            session.revision = self.revision
+            current = session.parent

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""Correlate native movement with engine-owned buffers and adapter completion."""
+
+from collections import Counter
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
+from typing import Literal, Protocol
+
+from vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_manager import KVCacheManager
+from vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_transfer import KVCacheTransferError, KVCacheTransferLease
+from vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_utils import (
+    BlockHash,
+    BlockHashWithGroupId,
+    make_block_hash_with_group_id,
+)
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.actions import CopyTo, MoveTo, Primitive, SetPriority
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.control import (
+    ControlError,
+    OperationRegistry,
+    OperationResult,
+    OperationStatus,
+    TargetOutcome,
+)
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.native import (
+    DemotePayload,
+    EvictPayload,
+    NativePayload,
+    PrefetchPayload,
+    RetainPayload,
+    SharePayload,
+    StorePayload,
+)
+from vllm.v1.kv_hints.state import LogicalResolution
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class KVTransferCompletion:
+    transfer_id: int
+    generation: int
+    success: bool
+    reason: str = ""
+    missing: bool = False
+    bytes_transferred: int = 0
+
+
+class KVTransferAdapter(Protocol):
+    tier: Literal["cpu", "mooncake"]
+    actions: tuple[str, ...]
+    limitations: tuple[str, ...]
+
+    def validate(
+        self,
+        direction: Literal["load", "store"],
+        key: BlockHashWithGroupId,
+        num_tokens: int,
+    ) -> None: ...
+
+    def submit(self, lease: KVCacheTransferLease) -> None:
+        """Queue local metadata; exceptions must leave no queued or worker access."""
+        ...
+
+    def poll(self) -> tuple[KVTransferCompletion, ...]:
+        """Report completion only after every worker has ceased buffer access."""
+        ...
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _Movement:
+    operation: OperationResult
+    payload: DemotePayload | PrefetchPayload | SharePayload | StorePayload
+    owners: frozenset[str]
+    keys: set[BlockHashWithGroupId]
+    pending: set[int] = field(default_factory=set)
+    succeeded: set[BlockHashWithGroupId] = field(default_factory=set)
+    errors: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
+    reasons: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+    outcomes: dict[BlockHashWithGroupId, TargetOutcome] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    unresolved: tuple[TargetOutcome, ...] = ()
+    transferred_bytes: int = 0
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _Job:
+    lease: KVCacheTransferLease
+    callers: set[int] = field(default_factory=set)
+
+
+class KVTransferOperations:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        manager: KVCacheManager,
+        registry: OperationRegistry,
+        namespace: str,
+        adapters: tuple[KVTransferAdapter, ...],
+    ):
+        self.manager = manager
+        self.registry = registry
+        self.namespace = namespace
+        self.adapters = {adapter.tier: adapter for adapter in adapters}
+        if len(self.adapters) != len(adapters):
+            raise ValueError("Only one native transfer adapter may own each tier")
+        self.resources = manager.get_transfer_manager()
+        self._operations: dict[int, _Movement] = {}
+        self._jobs: dict[int, _Job] = {}
+        self.statistics = {
+            "load_bytes": 0,
+            "store_bytes": 0,
+            "completed_transfers": 0,
+            "failed_transfers": 0,
+            "missing_transfers": 0,
+            "discarded_transfers": 0,
+        }
+
+    @property
+    def has_pending(self) -> bool:
+        """Whether request-free work still needs an engine progress tick."""
+        return bool(self._operations or self._jobs)
+
+    def submit(
+        self,
+        operation: OperationResult,
+        payload: DemotePayload | PrefetchPayload | SharePayload | StorePayload,
+        target: LogicalResolution,
+    ) -> None:
+        if isinstance(payload, PrefetchPayload):
+            tier, action, direction = payload.source, "prefetch", "load"
+        elif isinstance(payload, (DemotePayload, StorePayload)):
+            tier, action, direction = payload.destination, "demote", "store"
+        else:
+            tier, action, direction = "mooncake", "share", "store"
+        adapter = self.adapters.get(tier)
+        if adapter is None or action not in adapter.actions:
+            raise ControlError("unsupported", "No adapter supports this movement")
+        direction_value: Literal["load", "store"] = (
+            "load" if direction == "load" else "store"
+        )
+        selected: dict[BlockHashWithGroupId, int] = {}
+        outcomes = {}
+        for prefix in target.prefixes:
+            for block in prefix.blocks:
+                key = make_block_hash_with_group_id(
+                    BlockHash(bytes.fromhex(block.block_hash)), block.group_id
+                )
+                if key in selected and selected[key] != block.end_token:
+                    raise ControlError("invalid_payload", "Conflicting content spans")
+                adapter.validate(direction_value, key, block.end_token)
+                selected[key] = block.end_token
+                outcomes[key] = TargetOutcome(
+                    block.block_hash,
+                    block.group_id,
+                    block.start_token,
+                    block.end_token,
+                    OperationStatus.RECEIVED,
+                )
+                if len(outcomes) > self.registry.max_result_targets:
+                    raise ControlError(
+                        "capacity", "Operation target result capacity exceeded"
+                    )
+        unresolved = tuple(
+            TargetOutcome(
+                b.block_hash,
+                b.group_id,
+                b.start_token,
+                b.end_token,
+                OperationStatus.UNSUPPORTED,
+                reason="Range splits content",
+            )
+            for p in target.prefixes
+            for b in p.partial_blocks
+        ) + tuple(
+            TargetOutcome(
+                None,
+                gap.group_id,
+                gap.start_token,
+                gap.end_token,
+                OperationStatus.MISSING,
+                reason="Unrepresented range",
+            )
+            for p in target.prefixes
+            for gap in p.missing_ranges
+        )
+        if len(outcomes) + len(unresolved) > self.registry.max_result_targets:
+            raise ControlError("capacity", "Operation target result capacity exceeded")
+        movement = _Movement(
+            operation,
+            payload,
+            frozenset(p.continuation[0] for p in target.prefixes if p.continuation),
+            set(selected),
+            outcomes=outcomes,
+            unresolved=unresolved,
+        )
+        movement.errors["missing"] = sum(len(p.missing_ranges) for p in target.prefixes)
+        movement.errors["unsupported"] = sum(
+            len(p.partial_blocks) for p in target.prefixes
+        )
+        self._operations[operation.operation_id] = movement
+        approved = False
+        for key, num_tokens in selected.items():
+            try:
+                lease, created = self.resources.acquire(
+                    direction_value,
+                    key,
+                    num_tokens,
+                    operation.operation_id,
+                    scope=f"{tier}/{self.namespace}",
+                )
+            except KVCacheTransferError as error:
+                self._record_error(movement, error.code, str(error))
+                self._target_error(movement, key, error.code, str(error))
+                continue
+            if lease is None:
+                movement.succeeded.add(key)
+                self._target_success(movement, key)
+                movement.outcomes[key] = replace(
+                    movement.outcomes[key], reason="Already resident"
+                )
+                continue
+            movement.outcomes[key] = replace(
+                movement.outcomes[key],
+                transfer_id=lease.transfer_id,
+                generation=lease.generation,
+            )
+            if not approved:
+                self.registry.update(operation, OperationStatus.ACCEPTED)
+                approved = True
+            if created:
+                assert self.resources.start(lease)
+                try:
+                    adapter.submit(lease)
+                except Exception as error:
+                    self.resources.complete(lease, success=False)
+                    code = error.code if isinstance(error, ControlError) else "failed"
+                    self._record_error(movement, code, str(error))
+                    self._target_error(movement, key, code, str(error))
+                    continue
+                self._jobs[lease.transfer_id] = _Job(lease)
+            job = self._jobs.get(lease.transfer_id)
+            if job is None:
+                self.resources.cancel(lease, operation.operation_id)
+                self._record_error(
+                    movement, "busy", "Transfer belongs to another executor"
+                )
+                self._target_error(
+                    movement, key, "busy", "Transfer belongs to another executor"
+                )
+                continue
+            job.callers.add(operation.operation_id)
+            movement.pending.add(lease.transfer_id)
+        if movement.pending:
+            self.registry.update(
+                operation,
+                OperationStatus.RUNNING,
+                target_outcomes=tuple(
+                    replace(o, status=OperationStatus.RUNNING)
+                    if o.status == OperationStatus.RECEIVED
+                    else o
+                    for o in movement.outcomes.values()
+                )
+                + movement.unresolved,
+            )
+        else:
+            self._finish(movement)
+
+    def progress(self) -> None:
+        for movement in tuple(self._operations.values()):
+            if any(
+                self._jobs[job_id].lease.generation != self.resources.generation
+                for job_id in movement.pending
+            ):
+                self._cancel(movement, "Cache reset invalidated the operation")
+        for adapter in self.adapters.values():
+            for completion in adapter.poll():
+                job = self._jobs.get(completion.transfer_id)
+                if (
+                    job is None
+                    or job.lease.generation != completion.generation
+                    or job.lease.scope != f"{adapter.tier}/{self.namespace}"
+                ):
+                    continue
+                valid = self.resources.complete(job.lease, success=completion.success)
+                self.statistics[f"{job.lease.direction}_bytes"] += (
+                    completion.bytes_transferred
+                )
+                outcome = (
+                    "completed_transfers"
+                    if valid
+                    else "missing_transfers"
+                    if completion.missing
+                    else "discarded_transfers"
+                    if completion.success
+                    else "failed_transfers"
+                )
+                self.statistics[outcome] += 1
+                del self._jobs[completion.transfer_id]
+                for caller in job.callers:
+                    movement = self._operations[caller]
+                    movement.transferred_bytes += completion.bytes_transferred
+                    movement.pending.remove(completion.transfer_id)
+                    if valid:
+                        movement.succeeded.add(job.lease.key)
+                        self._target_success(movement, job.lease.key)
+                    else:
+                        movement.errors[
+                            "missing" if completion.missing else "failed"
+                        ] += 1
+                        if completion.reason and len(movement.reasons) < 3:
+                            movement.reasons.append(completion.reason[:512])
+                        self._target_error(
+                            movement,
+                            job.lease.key,
+                            "missing" if completion.missing else "failed",
+                            completion.reason,
+                        )
+                    if not movement.pending:
+                        self._finish(movement)
+
+    def cancel_owners(self, owners: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
+        for movement in tuple(self._operations.values()):
+            if movement.owners.intersection(owners):
+                self._cancel(movement, "Task finished")
+
+    def cancel_operations(self, operation_ids: set[int], reason: str) -> None:
+        for operation_id in operation_ids:
+            movement = self._operations.get(operation_id)
+            if movement is not None:
+                self._cancel(movement, reason)
+
+    def conflicts_with_explicit(
+        self,
+        payload: NativePayload | Primitive,
+        keys: set[BlockHashWithGroupId],
+    ) -> bool:
+        for movement in self._operations.values():
+            if movement.operation.origin is not None or not movement.keys.intersection(
+                keys
+            ):
+                continue
+            if isinstance(payload, EvictPayload):
+                return True
+            if (
+                isinstance(payload, (RetainPayload, PrefetchPayload, SetPriority))
+                or (isinstance(payload, CopyTo) and payload.dst.tier == "gpu")
+            ) and isinstance(movement.payload, DemotePayload):
+                return True
+            if isinstance(payload, (DemotePayload, MoveTo)) and isinstance(
+                movement.payload, PrefetchPayload
+            ):
+                return True
+        return False
+
+    def _cancel(self, movement: _Movement, reason: str) -> None:
+        caller = movement.operation.operation_id
+        for job_id in movement.pending:
+            job = self._jobs[job_id]
+            job.callers.discard(caller)
+            self.resources.cancel(job.lease, caller)
+        self.registry.update(
+            movement.operation,
+            OperationStatus.CANCELLED,
+            reason=reason,
+            completed_steps=self._completed_steps(movement),
+            affected_blocks=len(movement.succeeded),
+            transferred_bytes=movement.transferred_bytes,
+            target_outcomes=tuple(
+                replace(outcome, status=OperationStatus.CANCELLED, reason=reason)
+                if outcome.status == OperationStatus.RECEIVED
+                else outcome
+                for outcome in movement.outcomes.values()
+            )
+            + movement.unresolved,
+        )
+        del self._operations[caller]
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _completed_steps(movement: _Movement) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+        if not movement.succeeded:
+            return ()
+        return (
+            ("gpu_content_registered",)
+            if isinstance(movement.payload, PrefetchPayload)
+            else ("cold_copy_stored",)
+        )
+
+    def _finish(self, movement: _Movement) -> None:
+        errors = movement.errors
+        pool = self.manager.block_pool
+        affected = len(movement.succeeded)
+        blocked = errors["capacity"] + errors["busy"]
+        if isinstance(movement.payload, PrefetchPayload):
+            lost = {
+                key
+                for key in movement.succeeded
+                if not pool.cached_block_hash_to_block.get_blocks(key)
+            }
+            movement.succeeded.difference_update(lost)
+            for key in lost:
+                self._target_error(
+                    movement,
+                    key,
+                    "missing",
+                    "Destination was displaced before operation completion",
+                )
+            errors["missing"] += len(lost)
+            affected = len(movement.succeeded)
+        steps = self._completed_steps(movement)
+        if isinstance(movement.payload, DemotePayload) and movement.succeeded:
+            eviction = pool.evict_unreferenced(movement.succeeded)
+            affected = eviction.num_evicted_blocks
+            blocked += len(eviction.blocked)
+            if eviction.evicted:
+                steps += ("gpu_copies_reclaimed",)
+            for key in movement.succeeded:
+                outcome = movement.outcomes[key]
+                movement.outcomes[key] = replace(
+                    outcome,
+                    status=OperationStatus.PARTIAL
+                    if key in eviction.blocked
+                    else OperationStatus.COMPLETED,
+                    completed_steps=outcome.completed_steps
+                    + (("gpu_copies_reclaimed",) if key in eviction.evicted else ()),
+                    reason="Source remains referenced"
+                    if key in eviction.blocked
+                    else "",
+                )
+        if movement.succeeded:
+            status = (
+                OperationStatus.PARTIAL
+                if sum(errors.values()) or blocked
+                else OperationStatus.COMPLETED
+            )
+        elif errors["failed"]:
+            status = OperationStatus.FAILED
+        elif blocked:
+            status = OperationStatus.DEFERRED
+        elif errors["missing"]:
+            status = OperationStatus.MISSING
+        elif errors["unsupported"]:
+            status = OperationStatus.UNSUPPORTED
+        elif sum(errors.values()):
+            status = OperationStatus.FAILED
+        else:
+            status = OperationStatus.COMPLETED
+        self.registry.update(
+            movement.operation,
+            status,
+            completed_steps=steps,
+            affected_blocks=affected,
+            transferred_bytes=movement.transferred_bytes,
+            blocked_targets=blocked,
+            missing_targets=errors["missing"] + errors["unsupported"],
+            target_outcomes=tuple(movement.outcomes.values()) + movement.unresolved,
+            reason="; ".join(movement.reasons)
+            or (
+                "Target coverage is incomplete"
+                if status != OperationStatus.COMPLETED
+                else ""
+            ),
+        )
+        del self._operations[movement.operation.operation_id]
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _target_success(movement: _Movement, key: BlockHashWithGroupId) -> None:
+        steps = (
+            ("gpu_content_registered",)
+            if isinstance(movement.payload, PrefetchPayload)
+            else ("cold_copy_stored",)
+        )
+        movement.outcomes[key] = replace(
+            movement.outcomes[key],
+            status=OperationStatus.COMPLETED,
+            completed_steps=steps,
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _target_error(
+        movement: _Movement, key: BlockHashWithGroupId, code: str, reason: str
+    ) -> None:
+        status = {
+            "capacity": OperationStatus.DEFERRED,
+            "busy": OperationStatus.DEFERRED,
+            "missing": OperationStatus.MISSING,
+            "unsupported": OperationStatus.UNSUPPORTED,
+        }.get(code, OperationStatus.FAILED)
+        movement.outcomes[key] = replace(
+            movement.outcomes[key], status=status, reason=reason[:512]
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _record_error(movement: _Movement, code: str, reason: str) -> None:
+        movement.errors[code] += 1
+        if len(movement.reasons) < 3:
+            movement.reasons.append(reason[:512])
